paper.title: EntropyMoE: Entropy-Aware Sparse Expert Routing for Tokenizer-Free LLMs
paper.abstract: Recent byte-level large language models (LLMs) have made tokenizer-free modeling increasingly competitive by grouping bytes into dynamically sized patches. However, existing byte-patch architectures still apply the same dense feed-forward computation to every patch. This uniform computation cannot adapt model capacity to variations in patch semantics and granularity. We address this limitation with EntropyMoE, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture designed for dynamic byte patches. EntropyMoE

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 tokenizer-free LLM 中动态 byte patch 已经按预测不确定性调节粒度，但后续 Transformer 仍对所有 patch 使用同一套 dense FFN 计算的问题。作者想验证：BLT patcher 已经计算出的 next-byte entropy，能否同时作为 MoE 路由信号，用更低成本组织稀疏专家计算。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在两个点。第一，tokenizer-free 路线不只是在输入表示上绕开 BPE，还会改变条件计算的基本单位：路由对象从 token 变成变长 byte patch。第二，论文把“patch 粒度”“专家选择”“负载统计”拆开处理：entropy 决定路由，patcher 决定粒度，byte coverage 决定 workload accounting。这比直接把常规 MoE 搬到 BLT 上更干净。贡献量级偏探索性，不足以证明 tokenizer-free MoE 的明确 scaling 优势，但给出了一个可复现实验设置，说明低维不确定性信号有可能比 hidden-state router 更适合作为 byte-patch MoE 的路由坐标。
summary.technical_approach: EntropyMoE 基于 BLT 风格的 byte-patch pipeline。BLT 先用 next-byte entropy 决定 patch 边界：低不确定性区域形成更长 patch，高不确定性区域切成更短 patch。论文将 global patch Transformer 中的 dense FFN 替换为 Top-2 MoE 层，每个动态 patch 是一个路由单元。关键设计是 router 不看 patch hidden state，只使用该 patch 的标量 entropy，通过每个 expert 一个 slope 和 bias 的仿射变换得到 expert logits。hidden state 仍作为被选中 FFN expert 的输入，因此语义信息没有从专家计算中移除，只是不参与专家选择。作者没有让高 entropy patch 激活更多专家；每个有效 patch 固定激活 2 个 expert。计算自适应来自 patcher 的粒度变化，而不是 Top-K 的动态变化。负载统计按 patch 覆盖的 byte 数加权，而不是简单按 patch 个数计数，这一点适配了变长 patch。与 Hidden-only MoE、Hidden+Entropy MoE 相比，EntropyMoE 的区别是去掉高维 hidden-state projection，用一个一维不确定性信号形成路由几何。
summary.experiments: 实验是 continuation-training 风格的受控比较，模型和数据设置围绕 Dense BLT、Hidden-only MoE、Hidden+Entropy MoE 和 EntropyMoE 展开。稀疏模型使用 25 层、每层 8 个 experts、Top-2 激活，并匹配 active parameters、训练数据、更新步数以及 dense-copy 初始化。EntropyMoE 的有效 router 参数量约为 400，而 hidden-state router 对照超过 4×10^5，减少约三个数量级。主要结果是 EntropyMoE 取得最低 held-out bits per byte；Hidden-only 和 Hidden+Entropy MoE 接近 dense baseline，说明“有专家容量”本身不能解释收益。作者还用第二个 continuation-training seed 复现了 EntropyMoE 相对 Hidden-only MoE 的优势。下游任务上没有一致提升，较明确的正向结果主要出现在 HellaSwag。消融上，byte-weighted accounting 在两个 seed 上都优于 patch-count accounting。路由分析显示 EntropyMoE 对低 entropy 和高 entropy patch 的 assignment distribution 分离更清楚，但专家使用集中在少数 expert 上，说明还不能证明 learned expert identity 是不可替代的。效率上，EntropyMoE 在稀疏模型中 iteration time 和 valid-byte throughput 最好，但由于 dispatch、通信和内存移动，仍慢于 Dense BLT。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 BLT patching、entropy 和 MoE routing 的拆分，这是论文最有用的概念部分。然后看 Method 里 router 公式、Top-2 选择、byte-weighted load accounting，这些决定了它不是普通 MoE 的简单替换。实验部分重点看 Dense BLT、Hidden-only、Hidden+Entropy、EntropyMoE 的受控比较表，以及 byte-weighted vs patch-count 的消融。路由分布图也值得看，因为它能判断 entropy router 是真的形成了不同专家路径，还是只是在少数专家上塌缩。可以略读下游 benchmark，那里更多说明收益边界，而不是主要贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a tokenizer-free LM should also make its sparse computation tokenizer-free in structure. BLT-style models already use next-byte entropy to form variable-length byte patches, but the global patch Transformer still applies the same dense FFN computation to every patch. EntropyMoE tests whether that same entropy signal can serve as the routing coordinate for MoE layers.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution is not just adding MoE to a byte-level model. It clarifies how conditional computation changes when the routed unit is a variable-length byte patch rather than a fixed tokenizer token. The paper separates three roles that are often entangled: patching controls computational granularity, entropy controls expert selection, and byte coverage controls load accounting. This is a relevant design point for tokenizer-free pretraining. The evidence is still exploratory and continuation-training based, so it should not be read as a compute-matched argument against dense BLT. Its value is in showing that a low-dimensional uncertainty signal can be a stronger router than a high-dimensional hidden-state projection under this setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: EntropyMoE starts from a BLT-like byte-patch pipeline. The patcher uses next-byte entropy to create longer patches in predictable regions and shorter patches in uncertain regions. The dense FFN blocks in the global patch Transformer are replaced with Top-2 MoE layers, and each dynamic patch is routed as one unit. The central design choice is that the router only consumes the scalar entropy assigned to the patch. For each expert, a learned slope and bias map this scalar to a routing logit. The patch hidden state is deliberately excluded from expert selection, but it remains the input to the selected experts. The model therefore uses uncertainty for path selection while preserving semantic and contextual information inside expert computation. Every valid patch activates exactly two experts; the number of active experts does not grow with entropy. Byte length is used for workload accounting, which matters because patches cover different numbers of bytes.
summary_en.experiments: The controlled comparisons include Dense BLT, Hidden-only MoE, Hidden+Entropy MoE, and EntropyMoE, with matched data, updates, active parameters, and dense-copy initialization. The sparse setup uses 25 layers, 8 experts per layer, and Top-2 routing. The entropy-only router has about 400 effective routing parameters, compared with more than 4×10^5 parameters for hidden-state routing controls. EntropyMoE obtains the lowest held-out bits per byte, while the hidden-state MoE variants stay close to the dense baseline despite having the same expert pool and active capacity. The advantage over Hidden-only MoE is reproduced with a second continuation-training seed. Downstream accuracy is broadly similar; the clearest supported gain is on HellaSwag rather than a uniform task-level improvement. Byte-weighted accounting improves BPB over patch-count accounting in both tested seeds. Routing analysis shows clearer separation between low- and high-entropy patch assignments, but also concentration on a small subset of experts. Among sparse variants it has the best iteration time and valid-byte throughput, although sparse execution remains slower than Dense BLT because of dispatch, communication, and memory movement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Focus first on the introduction where the authors distinguish patch granularity, routing, and byte-level workload. Then read the method details for the entropy-only affine router, Top-2 expert selection, and byte-weighted load accounting. The most informative experiments are the controlled comparisons against Hidden-only and Hidden+Entropy MoE, plus the accounting ablation. The routing distribution plots are worth checking because they reveal whether entropy creates meaningful expert pathways or merely concentrates traffic. The downstream benchmark table is secondary; it mainly helps bound the claim.

recommendation.zh: 只看 entropy 路由与负载计量的消融；若结果干净，值得在 byte-level MoE 内部实验复现。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy-routing and workload-accounting ablations; if clean, this is worth reproducing in an internal byte-level MoE setup.

paper.title: Fine-grained Computation-Communication Overlap via Tile-level Signaling and Scheduling for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures increase model capacity without proportionally increasing computation cost and have become a key building block for scaling large language models (LLMs) to trillion-parameter regimes. Efficient deployment of these MoE models relies on distributed execution across multiple GPUs, where each MoE layer involves two all-to-all communications: dispatching tokens to expert ranks and returning the expert outputs to their source ranks. Conventional MoE implementatio

summary.core_problem: 分布式MoE推理场景下，专家计算完成后才启动返回路径的all-to-all通信，通信延迟处于关键路径，导致GPU利用率偏低。现有粗粒度分块重叠方法在小分块时损失张量核效率，且存在主机同步开销；内核融合方法则需要侵入式的自定义协议，实现复杂度高。
summary.importance: 为MoE大模型推理的计算通信重叠优化提供了一种轻量级方案，无需修改通信库或深度融合内核即可实现细粒度重叠，对MoE推理系统的工程实现有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是tile级设备信号协调的生产者-消费者模式。将专家输出投影GEMM（生产者）与返回all-to-all通信（消费者）作为持久内核，运行在独立划分的SM分区上，避免资源竞争。GEMM每完成一个tile就发出设备端信号，消费者检测到对应段的所有tile完成后，立即发起段粒度的远程写入，全程无需主机端同步。关键设计为remote-owner-aligned行布局，使每个输出tile仅对应一个目标rank，通信内核无需逐行路由逻辑，可直接执行连续写入。该方案既保留了完整张量核效率（无需切分小chunk），又避免了融合内核的高实现成本。
summary.experiments: 当前公开的部分内容未包含完整实验章节，核心贡献集中在方法设计层面，具体性能提升数据需参考原文完整版本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注tile级信号协调机制与remote-owner-aligned行布局的设计细节，以及性能实测章节（如有）。预计阅读时间15-20分钟，适合关注MoE分布式推理优化的系统方向研究员参考。

summary_en.core_problem: In distributed MoE inference, the return-path all-to-all communication is launched only after expert compute finishes, leaving communication latency on the critical path and reducing GPU utilization. Existing coarse-grained chunk-based overlap methods degrade tensor-core efficiency at small chunk sizes and incur host synchronization overhead; kernel fusion approaches require intrusive custom protocols with high implementation complexity.
summary_en.importance: Provides a lightweight scheme for compute-communication overlap optimization in MoE LLM inference, achieving fine-grained overlap without modifying communication libraries or building deeply fused kernels, with practical reference value for MoE inference system engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design is a producer-consumer pattern coordinated by tile-level device-resident signals. Both the expert output projection GEMM (producer) and the return all-to-all communication (consumer) run as persistent kernels on disjoint SM partitions to avoid resource contention. The GEMM raises a signal per completed tile; the consumer initiates segment-granular remote writes as soon as all tiles in a segment are ready, with no host-side synchronization on the critical path. A key optimization is the remote-owner-aligned row layout, which aligns each output tile with exactly one destination rank, so the communication kernel can issue contiguous writes without per-row routing logic. This design preserves full tensor-core efficiency (no small chunk splitting) while avoiding the high engineering cost of fused kernels.
summary_en.experiments: The provided partial content does not include the full experimental section. Core contributions are focused on method design; specific performance improvement metrics require referring to the complete paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the tile-level signaling mechanism and the remote-owner-aligned row layout design, plus the performance benchmark section if available. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. Relevant for researchers working on MoE distributed inference systems.

recommendation.zh: 针对 MoE All-to-All 通信瓶颈的底层系统优化，Tile 级别的细粒度重叠思路值得做 MoE 训练/推理系统优化的工程师关注。
recommendation.en: Low-level system optimization targeting the MoE All-to-All communication bottleneck; the tile-level fine-grained overlap approach is worth attention for engineers optimizing MoE training/inference systems.

paper.title: UMoE:Unlocking Every Expert in Domain-Specific Training
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity without proportional compute cost and have become a key architecture for frontier large language models (LLMs). Yet domain-specific post-training inherits an expert pool shaped by mixed-domain pre-training: a substantial subset of experts contributes little on the target domain, and standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leaves the composition of this pool unchanged. We propose a simple, budget-preserving pipeline that realigns the expert pool to the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 MoE 模型做领域后训练时的容量错配问题：预训练得到的专家池来自混合域分布，其中一部分专家在目标领域低相关，但标准 SFT 只是原地更新专家，并不会重新分配专家槽位。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口有实际启发。MoE 的专家专长来自预训练数据和路由动态，领域后训练如果不处理专家初始化，固定容量里会有一部分被低效使用。UMoE 提供了一个不增加推理成本的重组方案：先用目标域校准数据识别低 saliency 专家，再从高相关专家扩展回原专家数，最后做常规 SFT。贡献不在于新的 MoE 预训练算法，而在于说明 MoE 后训练可以先改专家池结构，再训练参数；这对领域专家模型、on-policy distillation 前的 specialist 构建有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: UMoE 分三步。第一步是 prune：在目标域 calibration subset 上为每层每个 expert 打分，默认使用 REAP saliency。该分数结合 expert 的 MLP 输出强度和 router gate 权重，并且只在该 expert 被 top-K 路由选中的 token 上求条件均值；如果没有被选中则分数为 0。作者按层保留 saliency 最高的一半专家，而不是简单按路由频率保留，因为高频不一定代表对目标域输出贡献大。第二步是 expand：从保留下来的专家通过扰动式扩展重新生成专家，把 expert count 恢复到原来的 E。第三步是 domain SFT：保持原始 E、top-K、参数量和每 token 推理成本不变，只改变专家初始化。和直接 SFT 相比，它显式重排专家槽位；和永久剪枝相比，它不减少容量；和一般 upcycling 相比，它的扩展源是目标域高 saliency 专家。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-30B-A3B，在五个目标领域和多个训练数据规模上评估；还在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的数学领域做架构迁移验证。论文报告 UMoE 在所有评估领域、架构和数据规模上相对直接 SFT 都有正向平均收益。数学领域分析显示，直接 SFT 后仍有一批专家虽然被路由使用，但 post-hoc pruning 后对性能影响较小，说明这些专家在目标域里较冗余；UMoE 让更多专家槽位对下游性能产生影响。给出的内容没有包含具体表格数值和提升幅度，因此阅读时需要核对实验表、不同 prune/expand 策略消融，以及 calibration size 对结果的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Method 的三步流程，尤其是 REAP saliency 的定义和按层保留 top-half expert 的理由。然后看实验表中五个领域的平均收益，确认收益是否集中在某些领域或数据规模。消融部分应重点看三点：只剪枝不扩展是否损失容量，随机扩展是否弱于 saliency-guided expansion，直接 SFT 是否确实保留了低效专家。对做 MoE 预训练的人，最值得深挖的是专家 saliency 与预训练专家专长之间的关系：目标域数据如何改变专家可用性，以及这种重组能否作为 continual pretraining 或 mid-training 前的初始化步骤。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses capacity misalignment in domain-specific post-training of MoE models. A pretrained expert pool is shaped by mixed-domain data, so some experts remain weakly relevant to a target domain, while standard SFT updates the inherited pool in place without reallocating expert slots.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at the interface between pretraining and post-training. MoE expert specialization is created by pretraining data and routing dynamics; during domain adaptation, part of the fixed expert capacity may be poorly initialized for the target distribution. UMoE proposes a budget-preserving way to reorganize that capacity before SFT. It is not a new MoE pretraining algorithm, but it gives a practical recipe for building domain specialists and for preparing specialist models that may later feed distillation or rejection-sampling pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: UMoE has three stages. First, it prunes low-saliency experts using target-domain calibration data. The default score is REAP saliency, which combines the magnitude of an expert’s MLP output with its normalized router gate, averaged only over tokens where that expert is selected by top-K routing; unselected experts receive zero score. The method keeps the top half of experts per layer. This is different from routing-frequency pruning, because frequent routing does not necessarily imply strong contribution to the target-domain computation. Second, it regrows the expert pool through perturbation-based expansion from the retained experts, restoring the original number of experts. Third, it applies standard domain SFT. The final model keeps the same number of experts E, active experts K, parameter count, and inference cost. Compared with direct SFT, it explicitly reallocates expert slots; compared with permanent pruning, it preserves capacity; compared with generic upcycling, its expansion source is selected by target-domain saliency.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-30B-A3B across five target domains and multiple training-data scales, with an additional architecture-transfer validation on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B for math. The paper reports consistent average gains over direct SFT across all evaluated domains, architectures, and data scales. A math-domain analysis shows that direct SFT still routes non-trivial compute to experts that are largely redundant under post-hoc pruning, while UMoE makes a larger fraction of the expert pool consequential for downstream performance. The provided content does not include exact table values or gain magnitudes, so the empirical strength should be checked against the main result tables, pruning/expansion ablations, and calibration-size sensitivity.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 25–35 minutes. Start with the Method section, especially the REAP saliency definition and the rationale for retaining the top half of experts per layer. Then inspect the result tables across the five domains to see whether gains are broad or concentrated. The most important ablations are: pruning without regrowth, random or non-saliency-based expansion, and direct SFT versus UMoE under the same compute budget. For MoE pretraining researchers, the useful question is how target-domain saliency relates to pretraining-induced expert specialization, and whether this kind of expert-pool reinitialization can be used before continual pretraining or mid-training.

recommendation.zh: MoE领域后训练的实用技巧，剪枝+再生专家池的思路可借鉴，重点看方法部分和消融实验。
recommendation.en: Practical trick for MoE domain post-training; the prune-and-regrow expert pool idea is worth referencing, focus on the method section and ablation studies.

paper.title: Mixture of Cognitive Experts in Large Vision-Language Models

Recent work suggests that cognitive elements, especially diverse representations and metacognition, correlate with better performance. summary.importance: 方法创新，提出证据驱动的多模态推理框架，将Bloom认知分类法与混合专家范式结合，提升LVLM的推理可解释性和准确性

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) apply a uniform perception-reasoning routing to visual queries of all cognitive levels, failing to fully leverage specialized CV models and suffering from hallucinations and poor verifiability
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing an evidence-driven multimodal reasoning framework that combines Bloom's cognitive taxonomy with the mixture-of-experts paradigm to improve the interpretability and accuracy of LVLM reasoning
summary_en.technical_approach: Mixture of Cognitive Experts framework: builds a hierarchical reasoning protocol based on Bloom's taxonomy, dynamically routes queries to specialized CV experts (detection, localization, state inference, spatial layout recovery, OCR, etc.) according to their cognitive demands, and integrates multi-source evidence to generate coherent, verifiable outputs

recommendation.zh: VLM领域的认知混合专家路由设计，对多模态MoE架构有微弱参考，仅看路由机制部分即可
recommendation.en: Cognitive mixture-of-experts routing design for VLM, offers marginal reference for multimodal MoE architectures; only the routing mechanism section is worth a look

paper.title: Director: Accelerating Distributed MoE Serving via Online Proactive Expert Placement
paper.abstract: Expert parallelism has become the prevailing paradigm to serve Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Its efficiency depends on the communication and computation latencies of the GPUs, which are linked to the placement of experts in the GPUs. Existing works for optimizing expert placement focus on leveraging past requests' expert activation patterns. However, they demonstrate deficiencies facing diverse and rapidly changing request patterns, calling for an online, proactive approach. Implementing such

summary.core_problem: 解决分布式MoE模型服务中现有专家放置方法依赖历史激活模式，在请求模式快速变化时效率低下的问题
summary.importance: 系统创新，提出预测驱动的在线主动专家放置框架，提升动态请求下的MoE服务效率
summary.technical_approach: 提出Director系统，通过轻量级级联预测器或低比特量化副本预测传入请求的专家激活模式，结合在线迁移策略优化专家放置，同时考虑激活不确定性、迁移成本和优化的NP难性，最小化端到端延迟
summary.experiments: 摘要截断，未披露具体模型规模、baseline和延迟提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses low efficiency of existing expert placement methods in distributed MoE serving under rapidly changing request patterns, which rely solely on historical activation patterns
summary_en.importance: System innovation proposing a prediction-driven online proactive expert placement framework to improve MoE serving efficiency under dynamic workloads
summary_en.technical_approach: Director uses either a lightweight cascaded predictor or low-bit quantized replica to predict expert activation patterns of incoming requests, combined with online migration to optimize placement while accounting for activation uncertainty, migration cost, and NP-hard optimization complexity
summary_en.experiments: Not available due to truncated abstract; no details on model scale, baselines, or latency improvements

recommendation.zh: MoE服务的工程优化，做MoE部署的可参考预测驱动放置的思路，预训练研究员仅需了解即可
recommendation.en: Engineering optimization for MoE serving via prediction-driven expert placement; only relevant for MoE deployment teams.

paper.title: TriRoute: Unified Learned Routing for Joint Adaptive Attention, Experts, and KV-Cache Allocation
paper.abstract: Conditional computation can decouple language model quality from per-token inference cost, yet leading techniques act on a single axis in isolation: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) sparsifies the FFN, Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) skips whole transformer blocks, and KV-cache quantization compresses attention memory.
