summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是条件计算被“分轴优化”之后留下的结构性浪费。现有做法里，MoE 只管 FFN 稀疏化，MoD 只管跳层，KV-cache quantization 只管注意力记忆压缩。它们都在降低推理成本，但默认这些决策可以独立做。作者认为这是假设错了：一个 token 该不该看全局、该不该走重专家、它写入 cache 时该用几 bit，这三件事在语义上是耦合的。稀有实体词可能 FFN 变换不复杂，却需要高分辨率注意力和高精度 KV；功能词则可能三者都可以降配。核心问题因此是：能否用一个统一路由器，在每层、每 token 上联合决定 attention resolution、expert selection 和 KV precision，并把 FLOPs 与 memory 预算折成一个可控旋钮，而不是分别调三套稀疏超参。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义主要在架构与 serving 接口。它不是传统 pretrain recipe 论文，但它触及一个越来越重要的问题：训练时若不把推理资源分配作为模型内部决策的一部分，后续再把 MoE、跳层、KV 量化拼起来，往往会出现局部最优和尾部 token 退化。TriRoute 的价值在于把三种条件计算统一成一个 joint routing 问题，并显式处理跨轴 collapse 和统一预算控制。若实验结论成立，这说明未来模型设计不该把“参数激活”“深度使用”“记忆精度”视为三条独立工程线，而应当共同训练。量级上，这更像一篇有想法的系统化架构论文：它未必立刻改变主流预训练范式，但对长上下文 serving、native sparse model、以及 train-time aware inference optimization 都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
TriRoute 的核心是一个共享 controller。对每个 layer、每个 token，它同时输出三类决策。第一是 attention mode，候选包括 skip、local-window、full，决定该 token 在当前层使用多少注意力分辨率。第二是 FFN expert routing，在 E 个专家中选稀疏子集，并引入一个 null expert，把 MoD 式的 FFN skip 视为专家选择的特例，而不是额外分支。第三是 KV bit-width，决定该 token 自己写入 cache 时用 2/4/8/16 bit 中哪一档，从而影响未来 token 检索它时的保真度。这个设计的关键不是把三件事并排放在一起，而是共享同一份 token 表征，让路由器学到“什么 token 值得在哪些资源上花钱”。

训练上有三块技术处理。其一，三类决策的离散空间异质性很强：expert routing 是大类别稀疏选择，attention mode 和 bit-width 是小规模但代价差异很不均匀的分类。作者采用按轴定制的 straight-through / Gumbel-Softmax 松弛，并做温度退火，尽量让梯度尺度可比。其二，作者强调 cross-axis collapse cascade：如果 attention router 先学会大面积 skip，下游 FFN router 看到的输入分布会退化，进一步失去区分能力，bit router 也会变得无意义。为此论文设计了 coupling-aware balancing objective，不只做单轴 load balancing，而是抑制一个轴塌缩后拖垮其他轴。其三，预算控制采用统一可微 cost model，把 FLOPs 和 KV memory 合成单一成本，再用在线 Lagrangian dual 调节，使目标平均预算 C* 成为唯一外部旋钮。这样用户不需要分别调 expert sparsity、depth sparsity 和 quantization ratio。论文还探索 shared vs separate routers，以及 token/per-head/per-layer-group 的路由粒度，最后发现 attention 用 per-head routing，而 FFN 与 bit routing 用 token-level，是较好的折中。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 160M 到 1.3B 的 decoder-only 模型，并按 compute-optimal token budget 训练。主结果是：在匹配推理 FLOPs 和 memory 的条件下，TriRoute 优于作者构造的“独立调优后再组合”的 MoD + MoE + KV-quantization baseline，形成更好的 cost-quality Pareto 前沿。摘要里特别强调它对 rare tokens 和 tail-case accuracy 保留得更好，这与论文动机一致：统一路由比单轴稀疏更能保护语义关键 token。全文还做了几类重要消融。第一，共享路由器通常优于完全分离的三个路由器，说明三轴之间确实存在可利用的相关性；但在极高 sparsity 下会出现表示干扰，说明共享并非无条件更好。第二，路由粒度上，attention 若只做 token-level 可能过粗，per-head 更灵活；而 FFN 和 bit-width 不一定需要更细粒度。第三，coupling-aware balancing loss 对训练稳定性有明显作用，没有它时会出现某一轴先塌缩、随后其他轴跟着失效的连锁现象。第四，统一预算控制能较平滑地扫出不同成本点，而不是三套超参各自漂移。当前公开内容里没有看到特别细的绝对数字表格，但从论文叙述看，作者重点不是追求单点最优，而是证明联合路由在同等成本下更稳、更能保住长尾 token 的质量。
summary.reading_guide: 先看 Introduction 和方法总图，确认作者统一的是哪三条资源轴，以及为什么它们不是独立决策。然后重点读方法部分的三块：异质离散路由的训练松弛、cross-axis collapse 的分析与 balancing loss、统一成本模型与 Lagrangian 预算控制。这三处决定了论文是否只是“把三种技巧拼起来”，还是确实提出了新的联合优化框架。实验部分优先看 Pareto 曲线、shared vs separate router 消融、routing granularity 消融，以及 tail-case/rare token 的分析。如果时间有限，建议 30 分钟读主线：方法概览 + 主结果图 + 三个关键消融。若要判断它对真实系统是否有落地价值，还要留意两点：一是训练时引入的路由复杂度是否会抵消收益；二是 per-token/per-layer/per-head 的动态决策在实际 serving stack 中如何实现，尤其是与现有 KV layout、kernel fusion、batching 策略的兼容性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural inefficiency in conditional computation. Current methods optimize different inference resources in isolation: MoE sparsifies the FFN, Mixture-of-Depths skips blocks, and KV-cache quantization compresses attention memory. The authors argue that these decisions are semantically coupled. A rare entity token may not need a heavy FFN transformation, yet it may still require full attention and high-precision KV storage because future tokens must retrieve it accurately. Function words are different on all three axes. The core problem is therefore whether one can learn a single routing policy that jointly decides attention resolution, expert usage, and KV precision for each token at each layer, while exposing one unified cost knob instead of three unrelated sparsity hyperparameters.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, the paper sits at the architecture/serving boundary rather than in classic pretraining recipes. Its main significance is conceptual: it treats compute allocation as a joint modeling problem, not as a post hoc combination of separate tricks. If that framing is right, then future sparse models should co-train parameter activation, depth usage, and memory fidelity rather than optimize them independently. That matters for long-context serving, native sparse architectures, and train-time awareness of inference constraints. The contribution is not a new language-modeling objective, but a fairly systematic attempt to unify three major conditional-compute mechanisms under one learned controller.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TriRoute uses a shared controller that emits three coordinated decisions for every token at every layer. First, it chooses an attention mode: skip, local-window, or full. Second, it performs sparse FFN expert routing over E experts, with a null expert that recovers MoD-style FFN skipping as a special case. Third, it selects the bit-width used when the token writes its own key/value to the cache, choosing among 2, 4, 8, and 16 bits. The key idea is not just to place three routers side by side, but to let them share token representations so the model can learn which tokens deserve which kinds of resources.

Training this system is nontrivial because the routing spaces are heterogeneous. Expert routing is a large sparse categorical problem, while attention mode and bit-width are small categorical choices with highly uneven sensitivities. The paper uses per-axis straight-through / Gumbel-Softmax relaxations with temperature annealing to keep gradients usable. A second technical issue is cross-axis collapse. The authors argue, and empirically show, that collapse in one axis can induce collapse in the others: if attention routing becomes overly skip-heavy, the FFN router sees degraded inputs and loses discrimination, which then makes bit allocation less meaningful. To address this, they introduce a coupling-aware balancing objective rather than relying only on standard single-axis load balancing. Third, they define a unified differentiable cost model that combines FLOPs and KV memory, and enforce a target average budget with an online Lagrangian controller. This gives a single external budget knob. The paper also studies design choices such as shared versus separate routers and routing granularity, finding that per-head attention routing with token-level FFN and bit routing is a good trade-off.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span decoder-only models from 160M to 1.3B parameters, trained at compute-optimal token budgets. The main empirical claim is Pareto improvement: at matched inference FLOPs and memory, TriRoute outperforms the best independently tuned combination of MoD, MoE, and KV quantization. The paper also emphasizes better preservation of tail-case accuracy, especially on rare or semantically important tokens, which is exactly where isolated sparsity methods often fail. Several ablations are important. Shared routing generally beats fully separate routers, indicating that the three axes do carry exploitable correlations, although interference appears at very high sparsity. Routing granularity matters as well: attention benefits from per-head decisions, while FFN and bit-width routing do not obviously need finer granularity than token level. Another key result is that the coupling-aware balancing loss improves training stability; without it, one routing axis can collapse early and drag the others down. The unified budget controller also appears to produce smoother cost-quality trade-offs than tuning three mechanisms independently. The paper’s emphasis is less on one headline benchmark number and more on demonstrating that joint routing is a better way to spend a fixed inference budget.
summary_en.reading_guide: Begin with the introduction and the architecture overview to understand why the three resource axes are coupled rather than independent. Then focus on three technical sections: the heterogeneous routing relaxations, the analysis of cross-axis collapse and the balancing loss, and the unified cost model with the Lagrangian budget controller. Those are the parts that determine whether the paper is merely combining existing ideas or actually proposing a new optimization framework. In the experiments, prioritize the Pareto curves, the shared-versus-separate router ablation, the routing-granularity study, and the tail-token analysis. A 30-minute skim can cover the method overview, the main result figures, and the key ablations. For a deeper read, pay attention to implementation implications: how much training overhead the controller adds, and whether per-token/per-layer/per-head dynamic decisions can be realized cleanly in real serving stacks with existing KV layouts, fused kernels, and batching constraints.

recommendation.zh: 想法比数字更值得看；只读 controller 设计和预算损失，别被未披露的加速结果牵着走。
recommendation.en: The idea is more useful than the reported numbers; read the controller and budget objective, not the unspecified speedup claims.

paper.title: DynaVieW: Schema-Guided World Modeling for Understanding Hierarchical Visual Dynamics
paper.abstract: Multimodal LLMs struggle to systematically model the temporal evolution of visual scenes in videos or multi-image sequences. Such inputs require models to predict or simulate multiple levels of dynamic constituents, such as actions taken in the visual sequence, and the associated changes to the visual environment that result. To address this challenge, we propose a dynamic schema-guided world model, DynaVieW, optimized for visual dynamic prediction and simulation. DynaVieW achieves an in-depth u

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型难以系统性建模视频或多图序列中的视觉场景时序演化，无法有效捕捉从高层动作到底层空间变化的多层级动态要素。现有交错视觉-语言预训练方法存在对齐弱、动态类型覆盖有限的问题，导致视觉序列生成一致性差、可控性不足。
summary.importance: 提出了层级schema引导的交错视觉-语言预训练范式，为多模态LLM的视觉动态理解与世界建模能力提升提供了新思路；状态-转换联合建模、带选择性注意力的混合Transformer专家架构、schema重加权损失等设计，对多模态统一预训练的架构与损失设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DynaVieW模型，通过在交错状态-转换序列上持续预训练提升视觉动态理解能力。状态为从多领域真实视频（日常活动、机器人操作、自动驾驶等）提取的关键帧图像，转换为层级JSON schema格式的文本，结构化描述相邻状态间的多层级变化。采用混合Transformer专家（MoT）架构，搭配共享多模态选择性注意力机制，通过丢弃冗余历史信息支持长序列学习。使用schema token重加权交叉熵损失，平衡格式规范与槽位值的学习权重。模型联合训练转换预测与状态模拟两个任务。
summary.experiments: 在视觉叙事任务上，零样本和微调设置下生成图像的一致性与整体质量均优于基线模型；可控性更强，在高层故事线不变时可灵活响应低层场景描述的调整。在世界模拟任务上表现超过基线，确定性视觉生成场景的指令跟随能力更优。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看引言的研究动机、状态-转换数据构造流程、模型架构与损失设计、核心实验结论。跳过具体的视频处理细节、实验参数配置与完整的结果表格。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal LLMs struggle to systematically model the temporal evolution of visual scenes in videos or multi-image sequences, and fail to effectively capture multi-level dynamic constituents from high-level actions to low-level spatial changes. Existing interleaved vision-language pretraining methods suffer from weak alignment and limited coverage of dynamic types, leading to inconsistent and poorly controllable visual sequence generation.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a schema-guided interleaved vision-language pretraining paradigm for visual world modeling, offering a new approach to improving multimodal LLMs' visual dynamic understanding. Designs including state-transition joint modeling, MoT with selective attention, and schema-reweighted loss provide reference for multimodal unified pretraining architecture and loss design.
summary_en.technical_approach: DynaVieW is a multimodal world model improved via continued pretraining on interleaved state-transition sequences. States are keyframes extracted from diverse real-world videos (daily activities, robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, etc.). Transitions are hierarchical JSON-schema formatted texts that structurally describe multi-level changes between adjacent states. It uses a Mixture-of-Transformer-experts (MoT) architecture with shared multimodal selective attention to support long sequence learning by dropping redundant historical information. A schema token re-weighted cross-entropy loss balances learning of schema format and slot values. The model is jointly trained on transition prediction and state simulation tasks.
summary_en.experiments: On visual narrative tasks, generated images outperform baselines in consistency and overall quality under both zero-shot and fine-tuning settings. It also shows better controllability, flexibly adapting to low-level scene description adjustments while keeping the high-level storyline unchanged. On world simulation tasks, it outperforms baselines with better instruction following in deterministic visual generation scenarios.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction (motivation), state-transition data construction pipeline, model architecture and loss design, and core experimental conclusions. Skip detailed video processing details, experimental parameter configurations, and full result tables. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；schema 化动态建模有价值，但要确认收益不是来自更强视频监督。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations; the schema idea is useful, but check whether the gains come from stronger video supervision.

paper.title: Worldscape-MoE: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts World Model for Scalable Heterogeneous Action Control
paper.abstract: World models are rapidly becoming a core infrastructure for embodied intelligence and interactive agents: they provide controllable simulators in which agents can perceive, act, forecast, and acquire scalable experience. Yet current video generation world models are still organized around isolated control interfaces, such as camera trajectories, robot actions, or hand-joint signals. This fragmentation is increasingly a scaling bottleneck. The central challenge is not the absence of controllable

summary.core_problem: 如何把相机轨迹、机器人动作、手部关节等“异构控制信号”统一到同一个可扩展的世界模型里，而不是为每种控制单独训练/适配一个生成模型。
summary.importance: 属于“可控生成世界模型”的统一接口问题：用统一建模吸收多种 action supervision，减少控制接口碎片化带来的 scaling 瓶颈；对做多模态/生成式 world model 的预训练配方与路由设计有参考价值，但对纯文本 LLM 预训练关联中等。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Worldscape-MoE：以 Diffusion Transformer 为骨干，在控制侧引入 Mixture-of-Experts，把不同控制类型视作对同一潜在世界动力学的不同约束；通过 MoE 路由把异构控制映射到共享生成主干上，实现可扩展的“多控制统一训练”。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确的模型规模、数据规模、对比基线与量化提升幅度；仅能确认其在“异构控制条件下的视频/世界生成”场景做验证，并强调可扩展性与统一控制能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to unify heterogeneous control signals (camera trajectories, robot actions, hand joints, etc.) into a single scalable world model, instead of training separate controllable generators per interface.
summary_en.importance: Targets the interface fragmentation bottleneck in controllable generative world models: a unified learning framework that can absorb diverse action supervision while sharing world dynamics. Moderately relevant to foundation-model pretraining researchers, more so for multimodal/world-model pretraining than text-only LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Worldscape-MoE: a Diffusion Transformer backbone with a Mixture-of-Experts control mechanism, treating different controls as different constraints over shared underlying dynamics; MoE routing maps heterogeneous controls into a shared generative core for scalable multi-control training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model/data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains; it only indicates validation on controllable video/world-model generation with heterogeneous controls and claims improved scalability/unification.

recommendation.zh: 把“多控制接口”问题用 MoE 路由统一到 diffusion world model 上，思路对做统一条件建模的人有用；但摘要缺关键实验细节，先看路由/训练目标再决定是否深读。
recommendation.en: MoE-routing as a unification layer for heterogeneous controls in diffusion world models is a useful design pattern; however, the abstract lacks critical experimental specifics—skim routing/training objective first.

paper.title: FRAME: Learning the Adaptation Domain with a Mixture of Fractional-Fourier Experts
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reparameterizes weight updates in a fixed basis: low-rank adapters operate in the spatial domain, while a recent line of spectral methods operates in a fixed Fourier domain. We argue that the choice of domain is itself a design degree of freedom that should be learned, and that no single basis is optimal across tasks, layers, or tokens. We introduce Fractional-Fourier Mixture of Experts, a mixture-of-experts adapter in which every expert carries a learnable

summary.core_problem: 解决 PEFT 方法中 LoRA 固定在空间域、谱方法固定在傅里叶域，单一基无法在不同任务/层/token 上最优的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将分数阶傅里叶域作为可学习自由度引入 MoE 适配器，实现空间-谱连续统上的自适应低秩更新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FRAME：分数阶傅里叶 MoE 适配器，每个专家携带一个可学习的分数阶傅里叶阶数，连续插值于空间域（等价 LoRA）和傅里叶域（等价谱适配器）；不同阶数的分数阶傅里叶算子天然互不相干，减少专家间干扰，token 被路由到低秩更新最紧凑的域。
summary.experiments: 在多种下游任务上对比 LoRA、谱适配器及其他 PEFT 方法，验证在相同参数预算下性能更优，且专家路由呈现出跨层、跨任务的域偏好差异。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation that PEFT methods fix low-rank updates in either the spatial domain (LoRA) or a fixed Fourier domain (spectral adapters), with no single basis optimal across tasks, layers, or tokens.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first introduces learnable fractional-Fourier domain choice into a mixture-of-experts adapter, enabling adaptive low-rank updates along a continuous spatial-spectral continuum.
summary_en.technical_approach: FRAME (Fractional-Fourier Mixture of Experts) equips each expert with a learnable fractional-Fourier order that continuously interpolates between the spatial domain (recovering vanilla LoRA) and the Fourier domain (recovering spectral adapters); operators of different orders are mutually incoherent, naturally reducing expert interference, and tokens are routed to the domain where each low-rank update is most compact.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against LoRA, spectral adapters, and other PEFT methods across multiple downstream tasks; achieves better performance under the same parameter budget, with routing revealing layer- and task-dependent domain preferences.

recommendation.zh: PEFT 方向的增量创新，分数阶傅里叶插值思路可作 LoRA 变体备查，不影响预训练主流程。
recommendation.en: Incremental PEFT innovation; the fractional-Fourier interpolation idea is worth keeping as a LoRA variant reference, does not affect the main pretraining pipeline.

paper.title: MEPA: Multi-Scale Representation Alignment for Visual Autoregressive Modeling with Mixture of Experts
paper.abstract: Visual AutoRegressive modeling (VAR) has pioneered a coarse-to-fine multi-scale autoregressive generative paradigm, demonstrating strong capabilities in image generation. However, VAR still suffers from inherent deficiencies in multi-scale representation learning. Specifically, lower scales primarily capture global semantics, while higher scales focus on fine-grained details. Employing a shared architecture across scales induces optimization conflicts. Moreover, due to the causal autoregressive

summary.core_problem: 解决 Visual AutoRegressive image generation 中多尺度表征学习冲突的问题：低尺度偏全局语义，高尺度偏细节，共享网络会让不同尺度的优化目标互相干扰。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是图像生成建模方法改进。它对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值主要在于：把 AR 生成、scale-conditioned routing、外部自监督特征对齐放在同一个视觉 token 生成框架里，可作为视觉 AR tokenizer/生成器设计的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MEPA：一是 scale-aware token-routed MoE，让不同尺度的视觉 token 选择不同专家，降低共享参数在语义尺度和细节尺度之间的冲突；二是在早期粗尺度引入外部自监督视觉特征，增强语义建模；三是设计 residual feature aggregation，避免简单特征对齐带来的表征干扰。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在图像生成任务上相对 VAR 类 baseline 改善生成质量，并缓解早期语义错误向高分辨率细节传播的问题；提供信息中没有给出模型规模、训练数据、FID/IS 等具体数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets representation conflicts in visual autoregressive generation, where coarse scales encode semantics and fine scales encode details, but a shared architecture is asked to serve both.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution for image generation. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect: it gives a concrete design point for scale-conditioned routing and feature alignment in autoregressive visual token models.
summary_en.technical_approach: MEPA combines a scale-aware token-routed MoE with external self-supervised feature alignment at early scales. The MoE separates experts by generation scale, while a residual aggregation design is used to avoid overly rigid feature matching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports improvements over VAR-style image generation baselines and claims better semantic consistency through the coarse-to-fine chain. The provided text does not include model size, datasets, or metric numbers.

recommendation.zh: 只看 MoE routing 和早期语义对齐设计即可；这是视觉 AR 的工程改良，不会改变语言建模 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the MoE routing and early semantic-alignment design; this is a useful visual-AR engineering variant, not a language-modeling prior changer.

paper.title: ExPLoRe: Expert Patch-Level Loss Routing for Multi-Objective Masked Image Modeling
paper.abstract: Multi-objective masked image modeling (MIM) combines complementary learning signals (token distillation, CLS alignment, and pixel reconstruction) but existing methods weight these objectives with global scalars, ignoring spatial heterogeneity across patches. We present ExPLoRe (Expert Patch-Level Loss Routing), which repurposes Soft Mixture of Experts (MoE) dispatch weights as learned, per-patch loss coefficients. The key mechanism is loss-coupling: allowing loss gradients to flow through dispat

summary.core_problem: 多目标 masked image modeling 通常用全局标量混合不同损失，无法根据图像 patch 内容动态决定该强化哪一种学习信号。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是自监督预训练目标改进。虽然工作在视觉 MIM 上，但“用路由权重控制不同 token/patch 的损失分配”对多目标 LLM/VLM 预训练有弱迁移价值，尤其适合思考 router 是否只该路由计算而不路由训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: ExPLoRe 将 Soft MoE 的 dispatch weights 复用为每个 patch 的损失系数，在 token distillation、CLS alignment、pixel reconstruction 等目标之间做内容相关分配。关键设计是 loss-coupling：允许损失梯度流经 dispatch weights 更新 router；detach 消融用来验证这一点。
summary.experiments: 在 ImageNet-1K 上使用 ViT-Base。相对非 MoE baseline，Token+CLS 组合提升 +0.5% k-NN 和 +4.4% linear probe；Token+Pixel 组合提升 +2.2% k-NN。最终达到 80.6% linear probe 和 85.3% finetuning accuracy。阻断 loss 到 router 的梯度会下降 1.6%。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-objective masked image modeling usually mixes losses with global scalar weights, ignoring that different patches may benefit from different training signals.
summary_en.importance: This is a self-supervised pretraining-objective improvement. Although it is a vision MIM paper, the idea of using routing weights to assign token-level loss mixtures has weak but real relevance for multi-objective LLM and VLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExPLoRe repurposes Soft MoE dispatch weights as per-patch loss coefficients across objectives such as token distillation, CLS alignment, and pixel reconstruction. Its key mechanism is loss-coupling: gradients from the loss are allowed to flow through dispatch weights into the router.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on ImageNet-1K with ViT-Base. Compared with non-MoE baselines, it improves Token+CLS by +0.5% k-NN and +4.4% linear probe, and Token+Pixel by +2.2% k-NN. It reports 80.6% linear probe and 85.3% finetuning accuracy; detaching loss gradients from the router degrades performance by 1.6%.

recommendation.zh: 只看 loss-coupling 消融；想法可迁移，但 ImageNet MIM 证据不足以改 LLM 训练配方。
recommendation.en: Read only the loss-coupling ablation; the idea may transfer, but ImageNet MIM evidence is not enough to change an LLM recipe.

paper.title: Mixture-of-Control: State-Aware Fine-Tuning for Transformer-based Models
paper.abstract: State-based fine-tuning has emerged as a compelling alternative to weight-based adaptation for transformers, updating lightweight controls into states rather than model weights, offering substantial memory savings while retaining parameter efficiency. However, most existing state-based methods typically apply only per-block control updates, which limits inter-block information exchange and restricts representational adaptation. Meanwhile, prior mechanisms that enable cross-block communication of

summary.core_problem: 现有基于状态的Transformer微调方法多仅采用逐块控制更新，限制了块间信息交换与表征适配能力，而支持跨块通信的现有方案计算开销过高难以落地
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出轻量级混合控制（MoC）微调框架，在保持参数与内存效率的同时实现了高效的Transformer块间信息交互
summary.technical_approach: 将各Transformer块的控制状态视为稀疏混合专家（MoE）过程中的专家，自适应整合局部与全局控制信号，以较低开销实现跨块的控制信息传递与表征适配
summary.experiments: 在多个Transformer基准任务上验证有效性，相比现有基于状态的微调方法取得更优的性能表现，摘要未披露具体模型参数量与量化提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing state-based Transformer fine-tuning methods mostly adopt per-block control updates, limiting inter-block information exchange and representational adaptation, while prior cross-block communication schemes incur prohibitive computational overhead
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing the lightweight Mixture-of-Control (MoC) fine-tuning framework that enables efficient inter-block information interaction for Transformers while maintaining parameter and memory efficiency
summary_en.technical_approach: Treats control states of each Transformer block as experts in a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) process, adaptively integrates local and global control signals to achieve cross-block control information transfer and representational adaptation at low cost
summary_en.experiments: Validated effectiveness on multiple Transformer benchmarks, outperforming existing state-based fine-tuning methods. Specific model parameter scales and quantitative improvement margins are not disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 参数高效微调的增量改进，仅在块间通信机制上做小创新，对预训练核心流程无直接影响，作为文献备查即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in parameter-efficient fine-tuning with minor innovation in inter-block communication, no direct impact on core pretraining workflows, keep as literature reference only

paper.title: Mixture of Debaters: Learn to Debate at Architectural Level in Multi-Agent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent debate frameworks suffer from two critical limitations: they rely on static architectures where agent roles and coordination patterns are fixed at design time, and they require instantiating multiple model copies, incurring substantial computational overhead. We propose Mixture of Debaters (MoD), a unified framework that enables dynamic self-debate within a single model by leveraging the Mixture-of-Experts paradigm. We address three key challenges in adapting MoE for dialect

summary.core_problem: 这项工作想解决多智能体辩论推理的两个工程性限制：角色和通信拓扑通常是预先固定的，难以随问题复杂度动态切换；同时，多智能体系统往往需要多份模型实例，推理成本和延迟较高。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更接近推理架构和参数高效微调方法。但它有一个有用的观察：MoE 的路由不一定只服务于容量扩展，也可以被设计成“推理过程控制器”，让不同专家承担提出、反驳、综合等功能。这个方向对研究 MoE 专家分工、推理时动态计算、以及多角色能力是否能内化到单模型里，有一定参考价值。贡献量级仍偏早期，关键还要看规模化训练和消融是否支持这些设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Mixture-of-Debaters。它基于一个冻结的视觉语言骨干，在 Transformer 中插入轻量 MoD adapter，用来替代标准 LoRA 的单一路径低秩更新。标准 LoRA 是一个固定的低秩旁路，MoD 则把低秩模块拆成多个专家池，并通过动态路由选择专家。核心有三点。第一是 dual-routing，把“角色分配”和“流程控制”分开：一类路由决定当前 token 或局部上下文应由 proposer、critic 等角色专家处理，另一类路由决定当前阶段是继续辩论还是进入总结综合。这样做的动机是，辩论不是普通 MoE 的单一专家选择问题，角色和阶段是两个不同维度。第二是 momentum switching，用局部上下文聚合来平滑 token 级路由，减少专家在短片段内频繁切换。这个设计针对辩论场景很具体：如果模型在一句话中不断从支持方切到反驳方，推理轨迹会变得不连贯。第三是 unified self-debate，把多个辩论角色封装进同一个模型的专家模块，避免外部多模型编排和多轮通信。与传统多智能体辩论相比，它把“多角色交互”改成了模型内部的动态专家选择；与普通 MoE 相比，它显式区分了角色路由和阶段路由。
summary.experiments: 给定全文片段没有包含完整实验表、具体 benchmark、参数规模、训练数据规模和消融数字，因此不能确认实际增益幅度。能从方法描述中看出的关键实验应包括：与标准 LoRA、普通 MoE adapter、多模型辩论框架的比较；dual-routing 的消融；momentum switching 对路由抖动、专家持续性和答案质量的影响；以及 text-only 和 multimodal reasoning 场景下的成本—效果权衡。若缺少这些消融，方法的主要证据会停留在架构合理性层面。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 §3.1 的 MoD adapter 结构，尤其是 dual-routing 的数学定义和 momentum switching 如何计算；再看 §3.2 的指令微调数据，因为显式 viewpoint shift 监督会直接影响专家是否真的学到不同角色。实验部分如果完整可见，重点看三类消融：去掉流程路由、去掉角色路由、去掉 momentum smoothing。真正需要判断的是收益来自“辩论结构”，还是来自更大的 adapter 容量和额外指令数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two practical limits of multi-agent debate systems: fixed role and communication patterns, and the cost of running multiple model instances to simulate debate.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining recipe, but it is relevant as an architectural probe into how MoE routing can be used for reasoning control rather than only for capacity scaling. It suggests that expert specialization can encode debate roles and reasoning stages inside one model. The idea is useful for thinking about MoE expert semantics, dynamic test-time computation, and whether multi-agent behaviors can be internalized by a single backbone. The current contribution should be treated as exploratory until larger-scale evidence and clean ablations are available.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mixture-of-Debaters builds on a frozen vision-language backbone and inserts lightweight MoD adapters in place of standard LoRA modules. A standard LoRA path provides one low-rank update; MoD replaces this with expert pools and dynamic routing. The main design choice is dual routing: one router handles role allocation, such as proposer or critic, while another controls the reasoning stage, such as debate versus synthesis. This separation matters because debate has at least two axes of control, and a single token-level MoE gate is a poor fit for both. The second component is momentum switching, which smooths routing decisions over local context. It is intended to prevent rapid expert flips that would make a debate trace incoherent. The third component is unified self-debate: instead of coordinating several external agents, the model stores debating personas in internal expert modules and activates them within one forward process.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include complete experimental tables, model sizes, data scale, benchmark results, or ablation numbers. The key evidence to look for would be comparisons against standard LoRA, ordinary MoE adapters, and external multi-agent debate; ablations for role routing, stage routing, and momentum switching; and measurements of both reasoning quality and inference cost. Without these numbers, the method is best read as a plausible architecture proposal rather than a validated scaling result.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on §3.1 for the adapter design, especially the exact definitions of dual routing and momentum switching. Then check §3.2, because the instruction-tuning data with explicit viewpoint shifts may be doing a large part of the work. In the experiments, look for whether the gains survive removing role routing, stage routing, or smoothing. The central question is whether the improvement comes from debate-aware structure, or simply from extra adapter capacity and supervised debate-style data.

recommendation.zh: MoE 路由用于推理时角色切换的思路有启发，重点看双路由设计与动量切换消融，不必全读。
recommendation.en: The idea of using MoE routing for test-time role switching is insightful; focus on dual-routing design and momentum-switching ablations, no need to read in full.

paper.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
paper.abstract: We introduce Agents-A1, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts Agentic Model that reaches trillion-parameter-level performance by scaling the agent horizon. We investigate agent-horizon scaling from two perspectives: scaling long-horizon trajectories and scaling heterogeneous agent abilities. To support this goal, we build a long-horizon knowledge-action infrastructure that connects external knowledge, actions, observations, and verifier outcomes, producing agentic trajectories with an average length of 45K t

summary.core_problem: 现有长程智能体的能力提升路径存在明显局限：扩参路线成本极高，中小团队难以复现同等能力；扩交互horizon路线则面临两个核心瓶颈——一是缺乏能连接外部知识、动作、观测、验证信号的统一数据基础设施，无法生成带过程监督的高质量长程交互轨迹；二是不同领域的智能体能力（多步检索、工具调用、迭代执行、验证反思等）推理模式差异大，整合到单一模型时易出现能力冲突。
summary.importance: 验证了“优先扩展交互horizon而非模型参数”的智能体能力scaling路径，证明35B参数规模的MoE模型通过长程过程监督，可达到万亿参数模型的长程智能体性能，为算力有限的团队提供了可落地的能力提升方向。基于知识-动作图的长程轨迹构建方法，为预训练、后训练阶段的过程级监督数据生产提供了可复用的框架。域路由on-policy蒸馏+显著词对齐的方案，为多域异质能力的整合提供了新的后训练思路，对多域持续预训练中的能力融合也有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案分为基础设施构建和三阶段训练两部分：1）长程知识-动作基础设施：搭建知识-动作图（KAG），整合外部知识、智能体动作、环境观测、执行结果、验证信号、失败案例等多源信息，生成平均长度45K token、带密集过程监督的长程智能体轨迹。2）三阶段训练流程：第一阶段，全域监督微调，让基座模型对齐通用的长程智能体行为模式；第二阶段，针对6个异质领域分别训练领域教师模型（采用针对性SFT或RL），获取各领域的专精能力；第三阶段，通过域路由的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）+显著词对齐整合多教师能力——域路由机制根据输入任务类型匹配对应教师提供监督信号，显著词对齐则缓解不同领域推理模式差异带来的能力冲突，最终得到单一可部署的35B MoE学生模型Agents-A1。
summary.experiments: 在SEAL-0、IFBench、HiPhO、FrontierScience-Olympiad、MolBench-Bind等长程智能体、科学研究类基准上，35B的Agents-A1性能超过Kimi-K2.6、DeepSeek-V4等万亿参数模型；在SciCode、HLE、BrowseComp基准上也取得较强结果。训练所用的长程轨迹平均长度为45K token，覆盖6个异质领域。
summary.reading_guide: 先泛读引言，重点理解参数scaling与horizon scaling两条路径的差异，以及horizon scaling的两个核心瓶颈。再看知识-动作基础设施的设计，尤其是知识-动作图的构成逻辑和长程轨迹的生成方式。随后关注三阶段训练流程，重点是域路由on-policy蒸馏和显著词对齐的具体实现。最后查看核心基准的性能对比数据，尤其是与万亿参数模型的横向对比。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing capability improvement paths for long-horizon agents have clear limitations. The parameter scaling route has extremely high costs, making it hard for small and medium teams to reproduce comparable capabilities. The interaction horizon scaling route faces two core bottlenecks: first, the lack of a unified data infrastructure that connects external knowledge, actions, observations, and verification signals, making it impossible to generate high-quality long-horizon interaction trajectories with process-level supervision; second, heterogeneous agent capabilities across domains (multi-step retrieval, tool use, iterative execution, verification, reflection, etc.) have highly divergent reasoning patterns, which easily lead to capability conflicts when integrated into a single model.
summary_en.importance: This work validates an agent capability scaling path that prioritizes interaction horizon expansion over parameter growth. It proves that a 35B MoE model can match trillion-parameter models on long-horizon agent tasks via long-horizon process supervision, providing an actionable capability improvement direction for teams with limited compute budgets. The knowledge-action graph based long-horizon trajectory construction method provides a reusable framework for producing process-level supervision data for both pretraining and post-training stages. The domain-routed on-policy distillation with salient vocabulary alignment offers a new post-training approach for integrating heterogeneous multi-domain capabilities, and also has reference value for capability fusion in multi-domain continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core solution is divided into infrastructure construction and a three-stage training pipeline. First, a long-horizon knowledge-action infrastructure is built: a Knowledge-Action Graph (KAG) is constructed to integrate multi-source information including external knowledge, agent actions, environment observations, execution results, verification signals, and failure cases, producing long-horizon agentic trajectories with an average length of 45K tokens and dense process-level supervision. Second, the three-stage training pipeline is implemented for the 35B MoE Agents-A1: 1) Full-domain supervised fine-tuning to align the base model with general long-horizon agent behavior patterns; 2) Training domain-specific teacher models for 6 heterogeneous domains via targeted SFT or RL to acquire specialized expertise in each domain; 3) Integrating multi-teacher capabilities via domain-routed On-Policy Distillation (OPD) with salient vocabulary alignment: the domain router matches the corresponding teacher to provide supervision signals based on the input task type, and salient vocabulary alignment mitigates capability conflicts caused by divergent reasoning patterns across domains, finally producing a single deployable student model.
summary_en.experiments: On long-horizon agent and scientific research benchmarks including SEAL-0, IFBench, HiPhO, FrontierScience-Olympiad, and MolBench-Bind, the 35B Agents-A1 outperforms trillion-parameter models such as Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4. It also delivers strong performance on SciCode, HLE, and BrowseComp. The training trajectories have an average length of 45K tokens and cover 6 heterogeneous domains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to understand the differences between the parameter scaling and horizon scaling paths, as well as the two core bottlenecks of horizon scaling. Then review the design of the knowledge-action infrastructure, especially the composition logic of the Knowledge-Action Graph and the long-horizon trajectory generation method. Next, focus on the three-stage training pipeline, with particular attention to the specific implementation of domain-routed OPD and salient vocabulary alignment. Finally, check the core benchmark performance comparison data, especially the horizontal comparison with trillion-parameter models. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读数据基础设施和蒸馏 ablation；“35B 到万亿级”先当营销口径，但 45K 轨迹构造值得拆开复现。
recommendation.en: Read the data infrastructure and distillation ablations; treat the 35B-to-trillion claim cautiously, but the 45K-token trajectory construction is worth dissecting.

paper.title: Learning Subset-Shared Invariances for Domain Generalization with Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Domain generalization (DG) aims to learn a model from one or more source domains that generalizes to an unseen target domain without accessing target data during training. A common approach enforces invariance of representations across all source domains, assuming predictive structure is globally shared. However, we demonstrate that enforcing invariance across more domains gradually restricts the feasible representation space, discarding transferable predictive factors that are not universally s

summary.core_problem: 域泛化任务中全局跨域不变性约束会压缩表示空间，丢弃非共享但可迁移的预测因子，导致泛化性能下降。
summary.importance: 提出子集共享不变性的建模范式，修正了域泛化领域全局不变性的默认假设，其思路对大模型多域预训练、MoE专家分工有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 假设预测结构仅在域子集内稳定，采用MoE架构，每个专家对齐其服务的特定域，通过路由机制组合子集不变分量进行预测，提出配套训练目标实现路由条件下的不变性学习。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体数据集、参数量与基线对比细节，核心验证了子集共享不变性相比全局不变性的域泛化效果提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Enforcing global invariance across all source domains in domain generalization restricts the representation space and discards non-universally shared yet transferable predictive factors, degrading out-of-distribution generalization.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the subset-shared invariance paradigm that revises the default global invariance assumption in domain generalization; the idea provides indirect inspiration for LLM multi-domain pretraining and MoE expert specialization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Assumes predictive structure is stable only within domain subsets, adopts a MoE architecture where each expert aligns domains it serves, uses a routing mechanism to compose subset-invariant components for prediction, and develops training objectives for routing-conditioned invariance learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific datasets, model sizes, or baseline comparisons; the work primarily validates that subset-shared invariance outperforms global invariance on domain generalization tasks.

recommendation.zh: 小模型域泛化任务的MoE子集不变性思路，对LLM多域预训练、MoE设计有弱类比启发，知道核心结论即可，无需细读正文。
recommendation.en: The subset-shared invariance idea with MoE for small-scale domain generalization offers weak analogical inspiration for LLM multi-domain pretraining and MoE design; just note the core claim without reading the full text.

paper.title: How Modular Is a Frontier Mixture-of-Experts? A Pre-registered Causal Test in Which Apparent Expert Modularity Mostly Dissolves
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a few of many experts, inviting the hypothesis that experts form functional modules tied to capabilities or languages. We test this causally on Command A+, a frontier open-weights MoE (218B total / 25B active; 128 experts, 8 active, +1 shared). We build a routing-mass atlas, pre-register six family-to-axis hypotheses before any intervention, and ablate each family at inference time against a size-matched random-expert null, measuring whe

summary.core_problem: 论文检验的是 sparse MoE 中“专家是否形成清晰功能模块”这一常见假设。更具体地说，routing mass 看起来能把专家分成语言、数学、代码等家族，但这些专家家族是否在因果上控制对应能力，需要通过干预验证，而不是只看 token 被路由到哪里。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 MoE 预训练和可解释性有直接价值。许多 MoE 分析会把高 routing mass 或高 lift 的专家解释为功能模块，但这篇工作显示，在 Command A+ 这个 218B total / 25B active 的开放权重 MoE 上，除 Arabic 外，大多数 apparent modules 在更严格的因果测试、跨指标测试和跨语料测试下不稳定。对基座研究员的启发是：expert specialization 不能只用路由统计判断；数据混合、router 训练、共享专家、量化和层间冗余都可能让“看起来专门化”的专家在因果上高度纠缠。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计比较克制。模型是 Command A+，128 个专家、每 token 激活 8 个专家，并有 shared expert；实验使用 W4A4 NVFP4 版本。论文先用 labeled probe corpus 记录每个 layer-expert 的 routing mass，并按 lift 预注册六个专家家族：math、code、general、Arabic、Chinese、Spanish。每个家族取 top-16 experts，排除 always-on shared experts。干预时使用 router masking：把被 ablate 的专家 router logits 置为 −∞，再做 top-k softmax 和 gate renormalization；smoke test 确认 masked experts 的 live routing 变为 0。因果判定有两个条件：on-target effect 必须超过同等大小随机专家 ablation 的 mean+2σ；worst off-target effect 必须不超过 on-target 的 1/3。论文同时报告预注册的 point rule 和更保守的 bootstrap 95% CI rule。为了避免单一指标制造结论，同一组 ablations 分别用 task accuracy、problem-text NLL、solution NLL、FLoRes/Belebele 语言 NLL、独立 Wikipedia 语言 NLL 来评分。Qwen3-30B-A3B 作为 sensitivity control，用来确认检测流程能找出已有文献报告的模块结构。
summary.experiments: 实验成本控制在 30 B200-hours 以内。Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，流程复现了较清晰的语言结构：language-language top-set Jaccard 为 0.60，language-task 为 0.19，gap 为 0.41。Command A+ 上对应分离弱很多：language-language 为 0.49，capability-language 为 0.40，gap 只有 0.09。六个预注册家族中，只有 Arabic 在独立 Wikipedia 语料和 bootstrap CI 下表现为稳健的因果模块。其他家族处在判定边界附近，结论会随语料、指标和统计门槛改变。论文还报告了两个重要负结果：高 routing-mass 的 shared-core 在因果上可冗余；高 lift 专家家族不一定有选择性，常表现为 entangled effects。任务 accuracy 切片较小，MATH-500 n=25、HumanEval n=60、MMLU-Pro n=80，binomial SE 约 0.03–0.10，因此论文更依赖 NLL 和独立语料 bootstrap 来给出主结论。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时先看实验协议，而不是先看 routing atlas。关键是三件事：预注册如何定义专家家族，random-expert null 如何控制 ablation 大小，1/3 selectivity criterion 如何把“有影响”与“选择性模块”分开。然后看四类指标的分歧，尤其是 task accuracy、problem NLL、solution NLL、语言 NLL 对同一个 ablation 给出不同结论的地方。Qwen3 control 也值得看，它说明 negative result 不是因为检测器完全失灵。最后看 failure modes 和 caveats：W4A4 量化、随机 null 只有约 10 次抽样、accuracy slice 偏小、router masking 与真实删除专家并不完全等价。这些限制不削弱核心提醒：MoE expert modularity 是因果问题，routing heatmap 只能作为候选生成器。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether experts in a sparse MoE are causal functional modules. Routing statistics often suggest families of experts associated with languages or capabilities, but such observational structure does not show that outputs depend selectively on those experts. The study tests this claim on Command A+, a 218B-total, 25B-active open-weights MoE with 128 experts and 8 active experts per token.
summary_en.importance: The result is important for MoE pretraining, interpretability, and model editing. It shows that expert specialization inferred from routing mass can be misleading. In Command A+, most apparent expert families do not survive a controlled causal test across metrics and corpora; Arabic is the only robust positive case reported. For pretraining researchers, the practical lesson is that router statistics should not be treated as evidence of decomposed capabilities. Shared experts, redundant pathways, layer interactions, and entangled routing can make a high-lift expert family look specialized while its causal role remains broad or replaceable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study builds a routing-mass atlas and pre-registers six expert families before interventions: math, code, general, Arabic, Chinese, and Spanish. Each family consists of the top 16 experts by lift, excluding always-on shared experts. The intervention is router masking with gate renormalization: masked experts have their router logits set to −∞ before the top-k softmax, and a smoke test verifies zero routing leak. A family is counted as modular only if its on-target degradation exceeds a size-matched random-expert null, estimated as mean plus two standard deviations, and its worst off-target effect is at most one third of the on-target effect. The paper reports both the pre-registered point rule and a conservative bootstrap 95% confidence-interval rule. The same interventions are evaluated with task accuracy, problem-text likelihood, solution likelihood, and per-language likelihood on both FLoRes/Belebele passages and an independent Wikipedia corpus. Qwen3-30B-A3B, with a similar 128/8 MoE shape, serves as a sensitivity control.
summary_en.experiments: The full study uses under 30 B200-hours and runs on the W4A4 NVFP4 build of Command A+. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, the pipeline recovers a clear reported structure: language-language top-set Jaccard is 0.60, language-task Jaccard is 0.19, for a gap of 0.41. On Command A+, the separation is much weaker: language-language Jaccard is 0.49, capability-language Jaccard is 0.40, for a gap of 0.09. Among the six pre-registered families, only Arabic is robustly modular under the independent Wikipedia run with bootstrap confidence intervals. The other families sit near decision boundaries, and their verdicts change with corpus, metric, or statistical rule. The paper also reports that the high-routing-mass shared core is causally redundant, while high-lift families tend to be entangled rather than selective. Accuracy slices are small, with MATH-500 n=25, HumanEval n=60, and MMLU-Pro n=80, giving binomial standard errors around 0.03–0.10; this is why the likelihood-based and bootstrap analyses carry much of the evidential weight.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the protocol before the atlas. The central details are the pre-registration of expert families, the size-matched random ablation null, and the selectivity criterion separating causal importance from modularity. Then inspect the metric comparisons: the same expert ablation can look modular under one measurement and non-modular under another. The Qwen3 control is useful because it shows that the procedure can detect modularity when the structure is strong. The caveats are also worth checking: W4A4 quantization, a relatively small number of random-null draws, small task-accuracy slices, and the difference between router masking and physically removing experts. The main durable point is methodological: MoE modularity is a causal claim, and routing heatmaps are only a way to propose hypotheses.

recommendation.zh: 用预注册因果消融推翻了MoE专家普遍模块化的默认认知，仅阿拉伯语族成立，应立刻调整内部MoE路由分析的实验范式，避免相关性结论误导。
recommendation.en: This pre-registered causal ablation overturns the default prior of widespread MoE expert modularity (only Arabic family holds), immediately update internal MoE routing analysis paradigms to avoid correlational bias.

paper.title: ZONOS2 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present ZONOS2 8B, our latest TTS model, which achieves state-of-the-art naturalness, prosody, and voice cloning fidelity. We improve upon Zonos-v0.1 across scale, data, and training recipe. We scale the model from 1.6B to 8B total parameters (900M active) with a novel mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbone, improving inference latency and throughput. We expand our training corpus from 200K to over 6M hours using a new data processing pipeline, and we simplify our post-training and conditioning re

summary.core_problem: ZONOS2 试图把开源 TTS 系统扩展到更大的数据和模型规模，同时保持语音自然度、音色克隆、可控性、多语言能力和流式推理延迟之间的平衡。
summary.importance: 这篇技术报告对预训练研究的价值主要在音频 LM 方向。它把 TTS 明确建成 decoder-only Transformer 对 RVQ 音频 token 的自回归建模问题，并给出规模化、数据管线、音频 tokenizer、MoE、delay pattern、字节级文本输入之间的工程取舍。相比传统 TTS 论文，它更接近“语音作为语言模型”的路线。6M 小时级训练语料、8B 总参数 MoE、900M active 参数，以及无需说话人标签的 voice conditioning recipe，都对语音 token 统一建模有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 模型采用 decoder-only Transformer MoE backbone，总参数 8B，单次前向激活约 900M 参数。音频由 DAC codec 编码为 RVQ token，报告中使用 9 个 codebook。模型对文本 token 和音频 token 做标准自回归建模。为了降低流式生成延迟并建模 RVQ codebook 间依赖，ZONOS2 使用 delay pattern：第 j 个 codebook 相对延迟 j 帧，使同一音频帧内的 codebook 依赖转化为序列上的自回归依赖。这样生成某个 codebook token 时可以条件化在同帧前面 codebook 的 token 上，而不是假设 codebook 条件独立。文本侧放弃 phoneme tokenizer，改用 UTF-8 byte tokenizer，以避免语言相关 G2P 和 OOV 问题，提高多语言鲁棒性。系统还提供 zero-shot voice cloning、语速控制和可选 Quality Mode；voice cloning 不要求训练时说话人标签，也不要求推理时克隆音频有转录文本。
summary.experiments: 报告给出的关键规模数字包括：模型从 Zonos-v0.1 的 1.6B 扩展到 8B total / 900M active 的 MoE；训练语料从约 200K 小时扩展到超过 6M 小时；音频 tokenizer 使用 DAC RVQ，N=9 个 codebook。评测覆盖质量、speaker similarity、WER，以及新提出的 ZTTS1-Eval。ZTTS1-Eval 包含 9 种语言的 clean read speech 和 17 种语言的 in-the-wild spontaneous speech，使用 Qwen3-ASR、ReDimNet、MSR-UTMOS，并加入 TTSDS2 和 DS-WED 来度量韵律分布和生成多样性。报告称 ZONOS2 在自然度、韵律和音色克隆上与强系统竞争，同时保持较好的流式延迟。给出的片段没有包含完整结果表，因此不补写具体分数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 40 分钟。预训练研究者优先看 Section II 的 model overview，重点理解 DAC RVQ token、delay pattern 和 MoE active 参数之间的关系。Section III 的数据管线值得扫读，尤其是 web-scale 语音数据如何支持多语言和 voice conditioning。Section IV 看训练 recipe 是否有可迁移到音频 LM 的细节。Section V 的 ZTTS1-Eval 可快速浏览，重点是它为何加入 prosody 和 diversity，而不仅依赖 WER。若只关心建模范式，Section II 最重要。

summary_en.core_problem: ZONOS2 addresses the scaling of an open-source TTS system while balancing naturalness, voice-cloning fidelity, controllability, multilingual robustness, and streaming inference latency.
summary_en.importance: The report is most relevant as an audio language-modeling artifact. It frames TTS as autoregressive modeling over RVQ audio tokens with a decoder-only Transformer, and documents practical choices around scale, data processing, codec tokens, MoE routing, delay-pattern decoding, and byte-level text inputs. This is closer to the AudioLM-style view of speech generation than to a conventional task-specific TTS pipeline. The scale is also informative: over 6M hours of training audio, an 8B-parameter MoE with 900M active parameters, and a voice-conditioning recipe that does not rely on speaker labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: ZONOS2 uses a decoder-only Transformer MoE backbone with 8B total parameters and roughly 900M active parameters per forward pass. Audio is represented with DAC, an RVQ-based neural codec; the report uses 9 codebooks. The model autoregressively predicts audio tokens conditioned on text and previous audio tokens. A key systems-modeling choice is the delay pattern for codebook generation. Codebook j is delayed by j frames, turning within-frame RVQ dependencies into sequence dependencies. This lets the model condition later codebooks of a frame on earlier codebooks of the same frame, instead of treating codebooks as conditionally independent. Text is represented as UTF-8 bytes rather than phonemes, which avoids language-specific grapheme-to-phoneme conversion and out-of-vocabulary handling. The system also supports zero-shot voice cloning, speaking-rate control, and an optional quality mode. The voice-cloning setup does not require speaker labels during training and does not require a transcript of the prompt audio at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The main reported scale changes are clear: the model grows from the earlier 1.6B Zonos-v0.1 to an 8B-total, 900M-active MoE, and the training corpus grows from about 200K hours to more than 6M hours. Evaluation covers audio quality, speaker similarity, WER, and the proposed ZTTS1-Eval benchmark. ZTTS1-Eval includes clean read speech in 9 languages and spontaneous in-the-wild speech in 17 languages. It uses current scoring components such as Qwen3-ASR, ReDimNet, and MSR-UTMOS, and adds prosody and diversity measurements through TTSDS2 and DS-WED. The report states that ZONOS2 is competitive with strong TTS systems while maintaining good streaming latency. The excerpt does not provide full metric tables, so exact scores should be checked in the evaluation section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–40 minute skim is appropriate. For pretraining researchers, Section II is the priority: inspect the codec-token setup, the delay pattern, and how MoE reduces the active inference footprint. Section III is useful for understanding how the large speech corpus is curated for multilingual generation and voice conditioning. Section IV should be checked for training-recipe details that may transfer to audio LM pretraining. Section V is worth a short pass because the benchmark includes prosody and diversity rather than relying only on WER. If time is limited, read the model overview first.

recommendation.zh: 大规模TTS的建模与数据scaling实践参考价值很高，重点看MoE架构设计章节与6M小时语料的处理流水线部分。
recommendation.en: The modeling and data scaling practices for large-scale TTS are highly referential; focus on the MoE architecture design section and the 6M-hour corpus processing pipeline.

paper.title: CogniRoute: Learning to Route Social Evidence in Omni-Modal Models
paper.abstract: Omni-modal models can ingest video, audio, and text, but unified access to multiple modalities does not guarantee that a model uses the right evidence. This gap is especially pronounced in social video question answering, where the answer may hinge on a gesture, vocal tone, temporal cue, or mismatch between what is said and what is visually expressed. We introduce CogniRoute, a schema-guided Mixture-of-Experts framework for social omni reasoning. CogniRoute uses a training-only cognitive schema

summary.core_problem: 全模态（Omni-modal）模型在处理复杂的社交视频问答时，难以准确判断应该依赖哪种模态（视觉、听觉或其组合）以及关键线索在时间上的位置，现有的 MoE 路由机制缺乏针对这种多模态推理结构的显式监督。
summary.importance: 提出了一种针对全模态 MoE 模型的模式引导（schema-guided）训练框架和路由感知强化学习方法，为解决多模态模型中的“证据选择”和“时间定位”问题提供了有效的解决方案，并构建了专门的评测基准。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CogniRoute 框架。核心创新：1) 模式对齐预测路由（Schema-Aligned Predictive Routing）：在 SFT 阶段，利用仅在训练时可见的“认知模式”（包含模态关系、推理需求、时间范围）来指导 MoE 专家的路由选择；2) 路由感知 MoE 强化学习（Route-Aware MoE RL）：在 RL 阶段，结合答案正确性、模态一致性推理和认知时间定位的 rollout 级别奖励，联合优化 token 生成和专家分配。此外，构建了 OmniSocialBench 数据集提供结构化监督。
summary.experiments: 在 OmniSocialBench 上，CogniRoute 达到 59.38% 的平均准确率，大幅超越闭源（+15.33%）和开源（+26.77%）基线模型，尤其在需要协调音视频线索的社交推理任务上提升显著。在 8 个公共音视频基准上也取得了提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注“认知模式”的设计及其如何指导 MoE 路由（Method 部分），以及路由感知 RL 的奖励函数设计。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Omni-modal models struggle to determine which modality (visual, audio, or a combination) to rely on and where the key cues are located in time when processing complex social video QA. Existing MoE routing mechanisms lack explicit supervision for this multimodal reasoning structure.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a schema-guided training framework and route-aware reinforcement learning method for omni-modal MoE models, providing an effective solution to the 'evidence selection' and 'temporal grounding' problems in multimodal models, and constructs a dedicated benchmark.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the CogniRoute framework. Core innovations: 1) Schema-Aligned Predictive Routing: during SFT, uses a training-only 'Cognitive Schema' (containing modality relations, reasoning demands, and temporal scope) to guide MoE expert routing; 2) Route-Aware MoE RL: during RL, jointly optimizes token generation and expert allocation using rollout-level rewards that combine answer correctness, modality-consistent reasoning, and cognitive temporal grounding. Additionally, constructs the OmniSocialBench dataset to provide structured supervision.
summary_en.experiments: On OmniSocialBench, CogniRoute achieves 59.38% average accuracy, significantly outperforming proprietary (+15.33%) and open-source (+26.77%) baselines, especially on social reasoning tasks requiring audio-visual coordination. It also shows improvements on 8 public audio-visual benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the design of the 'Cognitive Schema' and how it guides MoE routing (Method section), as well as the reward function design in Route-Aware RL. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将MoE路由与多模态证据选择结合，并引入RL联合优化路由和生成，对多模态大模型的架构设计和后训练有一定启发，可扫读方法部分。
recommendation.en: Combines MoE routing with multimodal evidence selection and introduces RL to jointly optimize routing and generation. Offers some inspiration for multimodal LLM architecture and post-training. Skim the method section.

paper.title: SPRI: SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization for Data-Constrained MoE Upcycling
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling, but training them from scratch remains prohibitively expensive. MoE upcycling mitigates this cost by converting pretrained dense models into sparse MoE models. However, existing upcycling methods typically rely on large-scale continued training and often perform poorly under data-constrained supervised adaptation, due to either homogeneous experts or overly disruptive perturbations to pretrained parameters. In this setting, effective upcy

summary.core_problem: 解决现有MoE upcycling方法在数据受限的监督适配场景下，要么专家同质化、要么对预训练参数扰动过大，导致性能差的问题（现有方法通常依赖大规模持续预训练）
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出基于预训练FFN权重谱结构的SVD拆分残差初始化方法，在数据受限场景下实现有效的MoE upcycling，同时引入两阶段训练策略提升稳定性
summary.technical_approach: 提出SPRI（SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization），将预训练FFN权重的SVD拆分得到的残差按谱结构分配给路由专家，在利用预训练权重结构的同时引入可控的专家多样性；配合两阶段训练策略提升适配稳定性
summary.experiments: 在多语言/多任务的监督适配场景下评估，摘要未披露具体参数量、数据集和baseline的精确提升幅度，仅说明SPRI在数据受限场景下显著优于现有upcycling方法

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses poor performance of existing MoE upcycling methods under data-constrained supervised adaptation, caused by either homogeneous experts or overly disruptive perturbations to pretrained parameters (existing methods usually rely on large-scale continued training)
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first proposing an SVD-partitioned residual initialization method based on pretrained FFN spectral structure for effective MoE upcycling in data-constrained scenarios, plus a two-stage training strategy for stability
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SPRI, which distributes SVD-partitioned residuals from pretrained FFN weights across routed experts to introduce controlled diversity grounded in pretrained spectral structure, paired with a two-stage training strategy to improve adaptation stability
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on multilingual/multi-task supervised adaptation scenarios; abstract does not disclose specific model sizes, datasets, or exact performance gains, only that SPRI significantly outperforms existing upcycling methods in data-constrained settings

recommendation.zh: 数据受限场景下MoE upcycling的初始化新范式，直接复用预训练FFN的谱结构，应立刻加入内部MoE ablation清单，重点看§3的初始化细节
recommendation.en: A new initialization paradigm for MoE upcycling in data-constrained settings, reusing pretrained FFN spectral structure; add to internal MoE ablation checklist immediately, focus on §3 initialization details

paper.title: Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts for Parametric Knowledge Injection
paper.abstract: Knowledge injection aims to equip large language models (LLMs) with external, domain-specific, or time-sensitive knowledge. Existing approaches typically face a trade-off between flexibility and integration: retrieval-augmented generation keeps knowledge outside the model but only provides prompt-level augmentation, whereas post-training based methods encode new knowledge into shared parameters but may introduce catastrophic forgetting, knowledge conflict, and costly updates. In this paper, we p

summary.core_problem: 在不频繁改动基座模型共享参数的情况下，把外部、领域或时效性知识注入 LLM，并避免 RAG 只停留在 prompt 层和继续训练带来的遗忘与冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模块化架构创新。它把知识更新做成可独立替换的专家模块，并把 router 与 base model 解耦，试图在参数化知识、可维护性和自回归推理效率之间取得平衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts：外部知识语料被转换为独立可更新的 expert modules；轻量 uncertainty-aware router 在生成时判断基座模型是否缺知识，只在需要时激活相关专家；为降低自回归推理开销，专家只接到最终层 feed-forward 位置，而不是深层全量插入。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、知识语料规模、baseline 列表或定量结果。可预期对比会包括 RAG、继续训练、参数编辑或常规 MoE 注入方法，并评估知识问答、遗忘、冲突和推理开销，但具体数字需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Qingyao Ai、Yiqun Liu、Jingtao Zhan 等，相关团队长期做信息检索、知识增强 NLP 和 LLM 检索增强研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to inject external, domain-specific, or time-sensitive knowledge into LLMs without repeatedly modifying shared base-model parameters.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a modular architecture for parametric knowledge injection. It turns knowledge updates into independently replaceable expert modules and decouples both the experts and the router from the base model, targeting a tradeoff among integration, maintainability, and autoregressive inference cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts converts external corpora into independently updatable expert modules. A lightweight uncertainty-aware router activates experts only when the base model appears to lack sufficient knowledge. For efficient autoregressive decoding, experts are attached only to the final-layer feed-forward path rather than inserted throughout the network.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, corpus sizes, baselines, or quantitative results. The relevant comparisons are likely against RAG, continued training, model editing, and standard MoE-style injection, with metrics around knowledge QA, forgetting, conflict, and inference overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Qingyao Ai, Yiqun Liu, and Jingtao Zhan, whose groups have substantial work in information retrieval, knowledge-enhanced NLP, and retrieval-augmented LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 只看 router 触发条件和 final-layer expert 消融；如果收益主要来自额外参数，架构结论要打折。
