paper.title: A theoretical model for task routing in mixture-of-expert transformers
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers enable the scaling of transformer models while keeping the inference compute fixed. While task-expert specialization has been observed in empirical studies of frontier MoE transformer models, existing theoretical work analyzes this using continuous mixture models that cannot be used to model natural language effectively. An important open question is to \textit{theoretically explain task-expert specialization in transformer MoE models using discrete models of lang

summary.core_problem: 这项工作试图用离散、语言式的数据模型解释 MoE Transformer 中的 task-expert specialization：为什么不同任务会被路由到不同专家，以及专家容量如何与任务复杂度相关。
summary.importance: 对 MoE 预训练研究的价值主要在理论直觉。现有许多 MoE 专家分化分析基于连续分布或前馈模型，难以对应自然语言中的模板、实体和事实检索。该工作把问题改写成模板加 key-value dictionary 的离散知识模型，给出 attention、router、expert 三者如何分工的构造性解释。它不能直接指导大规模 MoE 训练 recipe，但有助于理解为什么显式路由信号可能比只靠标准语言建模损失更容易形成清晰专家分工。
summary.technical_approach:
作者定义了一个合成知识数据模型。每个任务包含一组 syntactic templates 和一个有限 key-value knowledge table。模板中有两个 wildcard，分别填入 subject 和 object，生成类似事实回忆的数据。任务复杂度由模板规模和知识表大小共同决定。

在该设定下，作者构造单层 Transformer / MoE Transformer。attention 的作用是把句子的结构模板和事实 subject 分开；router 根据关系结构或模板信息把输入分配给任务相关专家；专家再执行任务内部的 associative retrieval，从对应知识表中取回 object。理论部分包括两个核心结果：一个是 dense Transformer 中可形成稀疏功能 circuit，另一个是 MoE Transformer 可用 task-specific experts 表示结构化知识，并且专家规模随任务复杂度增长。
summary.experiments: 实验使用合成知识数据，主要验证路由行为是否与理论构造一致。结果显示，显式 task-aware routing objective 会产生更清晰的 task-expert alignment；只使用标准目标时，也可能出现一定分化，但专家与任务的对应关系更弱、更不稳定。实验没有覆盖真实大规模语言模型，也没有直接给出工业级 MoE 的训练收益，因此结论应限定在理论模型和小规模合成验证范围内。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的数据模型定义，尤其是 template、wildcard、knowledge table 和 task complexity；再看 Theorem 4.2，理解 MoE 中 attention、router、expert 的构造性分工。Section 6 可以快速看实验设置和 task-aware routing objective 对专家分化的影响。证明细节可按需查阅，除非关注 MoE 理论或离散语言模型的可表示性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why task-expert specialization can emerge in MoE Transformers under a discrete, language-like data model, rather than under the continuous mixture models used in much of the prior theory.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is theoretical intuition for MoE pretraining. Empirical MoE systems often show expert specialization, but existing theoretical explanations usually rely on continuous distributions or feedforward-only models. This work introduces a discrete template-and-dictionary setting that better resembles factual language data. It gives a constructive account of how attention, routing, and expert computation can divide labor. The result is not a practical large-scale training recipe, but it helps clarify why explicit routing supervision can produce cleaner expert-task alignment than a standard objective alone.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The authors define structured knowledge data using syntactic templates and finite key-value dictionaries. A template contains two wildcard positions, which are instantiated with a subject and an associated object. A task consists of a set of templates and a task-specific knowledge table, and its complexity depends on both the number and length of templates and the size of the dictionary.

Within this setting, the paper constructs single-layer dense and MoE Transformers. The attention block separates structural information from factual subject information. The router maps inputs to task-specific experts based on relational or template structure. Each expert then performs associative retrieval over the corresponding task dictionary. The theoretical core includes a dense Transformer construction with sparse functional circuits and an MoE construction in which experts specialize by task, with expert size scaling with task complexity.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted on synthetic knowledge datasets. They examine whether learned routing matches the task structure predicted by the theory. The main finding is that explicit task-aware routing objectives yield substantially clearer task-expert alignment than standard objectives alone. Standard training may still produce some specialization, but the mapping from tasks to experts is weaker and less stable. There are no large-scale real-language MoE experiments in the provided content, so the empirical claim should be read as support for the theoretical model rather than as evidence for a production-scale MoE training method.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read should take about 20–30 minutes. Focus on Section 3 for the template, wildcard, dictionary, and task-complexity definitions. Then read Theorem 4.2 to understand the constructed division of labor between attention, router, and experts. Section 6 is useful for the synthetic routing experiments and the effect of task-aware routing supervision. The proof details are mainly useful for readers working on MoE theory or expressivity of discrete language models.

recommendation.zh: 从理论层面解释了 MoE 中的路由机制和专家专业化，将专家容量与任务复杂度挂钩，对理解 MoE 内部机制有启发，建议阅读理论构造部分。
recommendation.en: Theoretically explains routing mechanisms and expert specialization in MoE, linking expert capacity to task complexity; provides insights into MoE internals, recommended to read the theoretical construction.

paper.title: SHAPE: Coalition-Aware Expert Pruning for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models achieve strong quality with low per-token compute, yet their deployment is often limited by the memory wall: the full expert pool must remain resident to support token-dependent routing. Expert pruning is a direct remedy, but prior criteria typically score experts independently and overlook that MoE inference is inherently \emph{coalitional}, where outputs arise from routed top-$k$ expert combinations. We propose \textbf{SHAPE}, a task-driven

summary.core_problem: 现有MoE LLM的专家剪枝方法独立评估专家重要性，忽略了MoE推理中top-k专家组合的联盟特性，导致剪枝后性能下降明显
summary.importance: 方法创新贡献，首次将合作博弈引入MoE专家剪枝，建模专家间的协作关系，剪枝后可在相同内存预算下保留更高性能
summary.technical_approach: 提出SHAPE框架，将小校准集上的路由轨迹建模为经验合作博弈，通过基于观测到的top-k联盟的Shapley式归因，分配考虑交互的专家价值，识别对高效用协作至关重要的专家；进一步提出质量感知的全局剪枝策略，在预算约束下保留MoE拓扑结构
summary.experiments: 在多个MoE模型上测试，相比独立剪枝基线，在相同剪枝比例下性能下降更少，在相同内存约束下可获得更高的推理性能（原文摘要截断，具体数值未披露）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing expert pruning methods for MoE LLMs evaluate expert importance independently, ignoring the coalitional property of top-k expert combinations in MoE inference, leading to significant performance degradation after pruning
summary_en.importance: Method innovation contribution, first introduces cooperative game theory to MoE expert pruning, models the collaboration between experts, and retains higher performance under the same memory budget after pruning
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the SHAPE framework, models routing traces on a small calibration set as an empirical cooperative game, assigns interaction-aware expert values via Shapley-style attribution over observed top-k coalitions, identifies experts essential for high-utility collaborations; further proposes a quality-aware global pruning strategy to preserve MoE topology under budget constraints
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple MoE models, has less performance degradation than independent pruning baselines under the same pruning ratio, and achieves higher inference performance under the same memory constraint (abstract truncated, specific values not disclosed)

recommendation.zh: MoE专家剪枝的联盟视角非常关键，Shapley归因的思路可直接复现用于内部MoE的专家冗余分析
recommendation.en: The coalition perspective for MoE expert pruning is critical; the Shapley attribution idea can be directly reproduced for internal MoE expert redundancy analysis.

paper.title: Less is MoE: Trimming Experts in Domain-Specialist Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models achieve strong performance through conditional computation, but their large parameter footprint poses deployment challenges. Prior MoE compression approaches catastrophically fail when evaluated on general-purpose benchmarks beyond commonsense reasoning. We trace this failure to the granularity of compression: important capabilities are distributed across experts but concentrated in FFN sparse intermediate dimensions. To identify these dimensions, we use Fisher im

summary.core_problem: 现有MoE压缩方法均在整专家粒度操作，在数学、代码等通用基准上会出现灾难性性能下降，根源是压缩粒度过粗且重要性度量不准确。
summary.importance: 为MoE模型的部署压缩提供了可行方案，其发现的「MoE能力分散在各专家的少量FFN中间维度」这一结构特性，也能为MoE预训练的专家设计、参数分配提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 将压缩粒度从整专家细化到FFN中间维度，用经验Fisher信息聚合维度对应所有参数的重要性得分，按得分裁剪每个专家的低价值中间维度，对应调整FFN的gate、up、down权重矩阵尺寸，得到结构更精简的MoE模型。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen1.5-MoE上测试，50%压缩率下现有整专家裁剪方法在GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH等基准上性能崩盘；Fisher-MoE在相同压缩率下保留绝大多数下游性能，推理吞吐量提升21%。仅置零Fisher识别出的1.35M中间维度中的12个，就会摧毁数学推理能力但保留事实知识性能。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2章的能力归因实验、第3章的压缩方法设计，图2的不同压缩方法性能对比是核心结果，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MoE compression methods operating at the whole-expert granularity suffer catastrophic performance degradation on general-purpose benchmarks such as math and code generation, due to overly coarse compression granularity and inaccurate importance metrics.
summary_en.importance: It provides a practical solution for MoE deployment compression, and the discovered structural property that MoE capabilities concentrate in a small subset of FFN intermediate dimensions distributed across experts also informs expert design and parameter allocation in MoE pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method shifts compression granularity from whole experts to FFN intermediate dimensions. It uses empirical Fisher information to aggregate importance scores of all parameters corresponding to each dimension, prunes low-value intermediate dimensions per expert by the scores, and resizes the FFN gate, up, and down weight matrices accordingly to obtain a structurally compact MoE.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Qwen1.5-MoE, at 50% compression ratio, all existing whole-expert pruning methods experience severe performance collapse on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MATH. Fisher-MoE preserves most downstream performance under the same compression ratio and improves inference throughput by 21%. Zeroing only 12 out of 1.35 million intermediate dimensions identified by Fisher importance destroys mathematical reasoning while retaining factual knowledge performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on capability attribution experiments in Section 2, compression method design in Section 3, and the performance comparison of different methods in Figure 2. Estimated reading time is 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: MoE能力分布在FFN中间维度的结论修正了之前按整专家裁剪的思路，Fisher重要性的评估方法值得在内部MoE压缩实验中验证
recommendation.en: The conclusion that MoE capabilities distribute at FFN intermediate dimensions revises prior expert-level pruning ideas; the Fisher importance evaluation method is worth verifying in internal MoE compression experiments

paper.title: ProbMoE: Differentiable Probabilistic Routing for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale by activating only a small subset of experts per token. However, training such models remains challenging because top-$k$ routing is discrete and non-differentiable, requiring gradient estimators for expert selection whose design remains a central open problem. We introduce ProbMoE, a probabilistic routing framework that models expert selection as a distribution over cardinality-constrained expert subsets and formulates routing as probabilistic inference in

summary.core_problem: MoE 模型中的 top-k 路由选择是离散不可微操作，标准训练方法通过跳过 top-k 算子的梯度（仅让梯度流过 softmax 路由权重）来回避微分问题，导致路由梯度信号不完整——路由网络无法从备选专家子集获得学习信号，进而引发专家分布高度集中、专家利用率低、训练动态不稳定等问题。同时，动态 k（逐 token 自适应选择激活专家数量）路由缺乏统一的概率框架。
summary.importance: 将 MoE 路由重新表述为基数约束下的概率推理问题，并提供了可处理的梯度估计方案，为解决 MoE 训练中路由不可微这一长期问题提供了一个有理论基础的方向。Dynamic-k 变体将 exact-k 和动态专家分配统一到同一框架，为稀疏激活的计算自适应分配提供了新方法。对需要训练稳定 MoE 基座模型的预训练研究有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ProbMoE 将每个 token 的专家选择建模为基数约束下离散专家子集上的概率分布。训练目标变为在该子集分布下优化期望损失。前向传播中使用 SIMPLE（Ahmed et al. 2023）方法采样合法的 k-专家子集；反向传播中通过每个专家的精确边际概率来计算梯度，作为真实梯度的可处理替代。这种设计使路由网络能够获得关于各专家选择概率如何影响期望损失的信息梯度，同时保持稀疏专家执行。框架对底层 MoE 架构无侵入性，可灵活集成到现有 MoE 训练中。进一步提出 ProbMoE Dynamic-k：将子集分布从固定基数条件推广到可行基数范围条件，在同一概率框架内联合推断每个 token 的专家身份和激活数量，无需依赖阈值、空专家等启发式规则。
summary.experiments: ProbMoE Exact-k 在实验中提升了专家利用率和路由多样性。Dynamic-k 在动态设置下达到了有竞争力的性能，同时平均激活更少的专家。论文中未提供完整的实验细节（实验部分在提供的全文片段中被截断）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction（问题表述清晰）和 Section 3（ProbMoE Exact-k 的核心推导）。Dynamic-k 部分（Section 4）是概念延展，可快速浏览。预计阅读时间：核心方法部分约 20-30 分钟。值得深挖的点是 SIMPLE 梯度估计器在 MoE 场景下的实际稳定性，以及这种概率路由是否能在大规模预训练中替代现有启发式方案。
summary.authors_note: 机构与作者信息在提供的文本中未明确标注，无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The top-k routing in MoE models is a discrete, non-differentiable operation. Standard training bypasses differentiation by skipping gradients through the top-k operator and propagating only through softmax routing weights, resulting in incomplete gradient signals for the router. The router cannot learn from alternative expert subsets, leading to highly concentrated routing distributions, poor expert utilization, and unstable training dynamics. Additionally, dynamic-k routing (adapting the number of activated experts per token) lacks a unified probabilistic framework.
summary_en.importance: Reformulates MoE routing as probabilistic inference under cardinality constraints and provides a tractable gradient estimation scheme, offering a theoretically grounded approach to a long-standing problem in MoE training. The dynamic-k variant unifies exact-k and adaptive expert allocation within a single framework, providing a new method for computation-adaptive sparse activation. Relevant for pretraining researchers working on stable MoE base model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProbMoE models expert selection per token as a probability distribution over discrete expert subsets under cardinality constraints. The training objective optimizes the expected loss under this subset distribution. In the forward pass, valid k-expert subsets are sampled using the SIMPLE gradient estimator (Ahmed et al. 2023). In the backward pass, gradients are computed via exact marginal probabilities of each expert as a tractable surrogate for the true gradient. This design provides the router with informative gradients about how each expert's selection probability affects the expected loss, while preserving sparse expert execution. The framework is architecture-agnostic and can be flexibly integrated into existing MoE training. ProbMoE Dynamic-k further extends this to a range of feasible cardinalities, jointly inferring expert identity and activation count per token without relying on thresholds, null experts, or other heuristic gating rules.
summary_en.experiments: ProbMoE Exact-k improves expert utilization and routing diversity. Dynamic-k achieves competitive performance while activating fewer experts on average. Full experimental details are not available in the provided text fragment (the experiments section is truncated).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction (clear problem formulation) and Section 3 (core derivation of ProbMoE Exact-k). The Dynamic-k section (Section 4) is a conceptual extension and can be skimmed. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes for the core method. Worth digging into: practical stability of the SIMPLE gradient estimator in MoE settings, and whether this probabilistic routing can replace existing heuristic schemes at scale.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not clearly identified in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: MoE路由可微化的一条扎实路径，用精确边缘概率替代straight-through梯度估计的思路值得在内部ablation复现；动态k路由或可缓解load imbalance问题。
recommendation.en: A solid path toward differentiable MoE routing; using exact marginal probabilities as gradient surrogates is worth reproducing in internal ablations, and dynamic-k routing may help mitigate load imbalance.

paper.title: DOT-MoE: Differentiable Optimal Transport for MoEfication
paper.abstract: The scaling of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven significant performance gains but created substantial challenges in inference efficiency. While Mixture of Experts (MoEs) architectures address this by decoupling model size from inference cost, training MoEs from scratch is often unstable and compute intensive. Conversion of pre-trained dense models into sparse MoEs has emerged as an alternative solution; however, existing methods typically rely on heuristic neuron clustering or random spli

summary.core_problem: 将预训练稠密 Transformer 模型转换为稀疏 MoE（MoEfication）时，中间层神经元如何分配给各个专家是核心挑战。现有方法依赖启发式神经元聚类或随机分割，并将神经元分配与路由训练视为独立的两阶段过程，缺乏统一的可微框架来同时保证专家容量平衡和 token 语义路由优化。
summary.importance: 将最优传输理论引入 MoEfication 问题，提出首个端到端可微的稠密到 MoE 转换框架，允许路由器和专家分配协同适应。对于需要将现有稠密基座模型高效稀疏化的研究（如大模型推理加速、参数量缩减）有实用参考价值。同时对比了结构化剪枝与 MoEfication 两条路线的优劣，对模型压缩方向有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: DOT-MoE 将稠密 FFN 层的神经元分配建模为带容量约束的可微最优传输（DOT）问题。用可微 Sinkhorn-Knopp 迭代求解该运输问题，并使用 Straight-Through Estimator（STE）让梯度流过离散的分配决策。设计了双层分配机制：神经元到专家的分解和 token 到专家的路由通过互补的 STE 联合优化，使路由器和专家结构能够协同适应，区别于现有方法中先冻结分配再训练路由的两阶段策略。这保证了专家不仅是随机神经元集合，而是为特定路由策略优化的平衡功能单元。
summary.experiments: 在三个模型家族（LLaMA-2、LLaMA-3、Qwen2.5）和六个基准测试上进行了广泛实验。DOT-MoE 在 50% 参数量时保留原稠密模型约 90% 的性能，表现优于结构化剪枝方法（ShortGPT、SliceGPT、DISP-LLM 等）和现有的 MoEfication 方法。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction（动机清晰）和核心方法部分（Sinkhorn 迭代与 STE 的具体结合方式）。实验部分可快速浏览主要结果。预计阅读时间：20-30 分钟。值得关注的是 Sinkhorn 迭代的计算开销（每步路由都需要解 OT 问题）是否会在实际部署中成为瓶颈。
summary.authors_note: 机构与作者信息在提供的文本中未明确标注，无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: When converting a pre-trained dense Transformer to a sparse MoE (MoEfication), the core challenge is how to assign intermediate-layer neurons to individual experts. Existing methods rely on heuristic neuron clustering or random splitting and treat neuron assignment and router training as separate two-stage processes, lacking a unified differentiable framework to simultaneously guarantee balanced expert capacity and optimize semantic token routing.
summary_en.importance: Introduces optimal transport theory to the MoEfication problem and proposes the first end-to-end differentiable dense-to-MoE conversion framework, allowing co-adaptation of the router and expert assignment. Practically relevant for research on efficient sparsification of existing dense base models (e.g., inference acceleration, parameter reduction). Also provides a useful comparison between structured pruning and MoEfication approaches for model compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: DOT-MoE formulates neuron assignment in dense FFN layers as a Differentiable Optimal Transport (DOT) problem with capacity constraints. The transport problem is solved via differentiable Sinkhorn-Knopp iterations, and Straight-Through Estimators (STE) allow gradients to flow through discrete assignment decisions. A dual-level assignment mechanism is designed: neuron-to-expert decomposition and token-to-expert routing are jointly optimized via complementary STEs, enabling co-adaptation of the router and expert structure — unlike prior methods that freeze the assignment before training the router. This ensures experts are not random collections of neurons but balanced functional units optimized for the specific routing policy.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments across three model families (LLaMA-2, LLaMA-3, Qwen2.5) and six benchmarks. DOT-MoE retains approximately 90% of the original dense model's performance at 50% parameter count, outperforming both structured pruning methods (ShortGPT, SliceGPT, DISP-LLM) and existing MoEfication approaches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction (clear motivation) and the core method section (specific integration of Sinkhorn iterations with STE). The experiments section can be skimmed for main results. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes. Worth investigating: whether the computational overhead of Sinkhorn iterations (solving OT at every routing step) becomes a practical deployment bottleneck.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not clearly identified in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 用可微最优运输替代启发式聚类做MoE拆分，核心思路扎实，值得在内部MoE转换实验中做小范围ablation验证。
recommendation.en: Replaces heuristic clustering for MoE splitting with differentiable optimal transport, solid core idea, worth small-scale ablation in internal MoE conversion experiments.

paper.title: Dialectics of Alignment: Harnessing Unsafe Knowledge for Dynamic Safety Routing
paper.abstract: The prevailing paradigm in large language model (LLM) alignment operates via erasure, filtering unsafe data or training models to strictly refuse harmful prompts. While effective at reducing immediate toxicity, this approach fundamentally constricts the model's epistemological scope, resulting in over-cautious systems that output uninformative blanket refusals to sensitive yet benign queries. In this work, we challenge the orthodoxy that unsafe data must be discarded. We propose a dialectical ap

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个常见但少被正面拆开的对齐问题：现有安全对齐往往靠删数据、强拒答、统一压制危险话题，短期上能降有害输出，但代价是把与危险领域相关的知识也一并抹平，最后模型在敏感但正当的问题上只会给模板化拒绝。作者要解决的不是“如何让模型更会拒绝”，而是“能否保留不安全数据中的领域知识，再用很少量安全样本把这些知识重新组织成安全且有信息量的回答”。换句话说，目标是把 unsafe knowledge 从直接生成危险内容，变成受控调用的知识部件。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于提出了新的基座训练范式，而在于它触到一个很实际的 pretrain↔post-train 接口问题：危险数据到底应被彻底过滤，还是应被结构化保留。SafeMoE 给出的答案是后者，而且用模块隔离而不是参数层面的整体遗忘。这个思路对数据配比、持续预训练、领域知识保留、以及安全对齐中的“知识损失”问题都有启发。贡献量级更接近一种有明确工程可行性的对齐结构设计，而不是会改写基座预训练主流程的方法。它的价值主要在两个点：第一，提出 unsafe data 也可作为知识源，而不是只被视为噪声；第二，用极少量安全数据训练路由器，尝试把高成本安全标注从“覆盖全部知识”降到“控制知识调用”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 SafeMoE。它不是训练一个标准稀疏 MoE 主干，而是在共享底座模型上挂接多个 domain-specific LoRA experts，把不同危险领域中的知识分别装进低秩适配器里。这里的设计动机很清楚：如果直接把 unsafe data 混进统一参数更新，知识和行为会纠缠，后续很难只保留知识而压制危险行为；而把它们封装进专家后，至少在结构上可以把“知道什么”和“何时调用”部分拆开。

训练流程大致分两段。第一段，用不安全领域数据分别训练 LoRA expert，让每个 expert 学到某一类敏感主题的细粒度知识原语。第二段，不再主要依赖大规模安全监督去重写这些知识，而是用一个很小、人工精修的 safe response 数据集训练 router。这个 router 在推理时根据输入动态决定激活哪些专家，以及激活强度，从而把原本可能导向有害细节的知识，重组为安全、解释性更强、且不只是拒答的输出。

从全文描述看，作者强调的不是“unsafe expert 自己会变安全”，而是“unsafe expert 保留知识，安全性由路由与组合来保证”。这和常见 SFT/RLHF 直接在主模型上压行为不同，也和简单的拒答分类器不同。它更像把安全对齐做成一个受控检索/受控组合问题。另一个关键点是作者把 informativeness 明确定义为两件事：避免 blanket refusal，同时提供相关且有帮助的信息，但不泄露会造成伤害的操作细节。这个定义决定了训练目标不是单纯 toxicity minimization，而是 safety-utility trade-off 的结构化优化。

从方法边界看，这套方案依赖两个假设：一是危险知识可以按领域分解并由 LoRA 局部承载；二是少量安全样本足以学到“何时、如何调用这些知识”。如果领域边界模糊，或者危险行为与普通知识高度耦合，router 可能会变成新的脆弱点。全文里作者把这种风险部分交给人工精修的小规模安全集和人工评测来兜底。
summary.experiments:
实验结论是：SafeMoE 相比标准安全对齐基线，能明显减少空泛拒答，同时不显著放松安全边界。全文里最值得记的不是单一分数，而是实验设置本身：作者强调 router 训练只用不到 800 条安全样本，且在更激进设置下可降到约 100 条，覆盖主题也有限。这说明方法想证明的是 sample efficiency，而不是靠大规模安全数据堆出来的效果。

评测维度主要有两类。第一类是安全性：模型是否暴露危险步骤、是否给出可执行有害细节。第二类是信息量：面对敏感问题时，是否能给出解释、替代建议、风险说明、求助路径，而不是统一拒绝。作者还做了人工标注，结论与自动指标一致：SafeMoE 生成的回答更接近“安全但有帮助”的人类偏好，而不是简单更长或更委婉。

从摘要和正文可确认的关键数字只有安全样本规模这一组：少于 800 条，甚至约 100 条。全文片段中没有给出你提供材料里完整的 benchmark 名称、基座规模、各基线具体提升百分点，因此不能编造具体数值。能确定的是作者把 human annotation 作为重要证据，而不是只报自动安全分数；这说明他们知道该任务里自动指标容易把“拒答”误判成高安全。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐节深抠公式。先看 Introduction，重点理解作者为什么反对 safety-by-erasure，以及为什么把 unsafe data 视为知识资产而不是纯风险源。再看 Methodology，抓住两个结构点：unsafe knowledge 用 LoRA expert 隔离；safe behavior 用小数据 router 控制。只要这两个点想清楚，整篇方法就基本明白了。

阅读时建议重点看三处。第一，看图 1 一类的案例对比，作者如何区分 unsafe、refusal、safe-informative 三种回答，这决定了任务定义。第二，看 router 的训练数据构成和推理时的激活机制，这部分关系到方法是否真有样本效率。第三，看人工评测协议，尤其是如何同时评安全和信息量，因为这是这类工作最容易“指标好看、体验很差”的地方。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，建议读引言、方法总览图、实验主表和人工评测部分。若要深挖，值得追问两件事：一，LoRA expert 是否真的学到可分离的领域知识，还是只是把危险风格局部化；二，router 在分布外敏感问题上是否会失效，导致错误调用或过度保守。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of safety alignment: current pipelines often remove unsafe data or train blanket refusals, which reduces harmful outputs but also strips away domain knowledge tied to sensitive topics. The result is an over-cautious model that refuses even benign or help-seeking queries. The actual question here is not how to refuse better, but whether unsafe data can be retained as a knowledge source and then controlled so the model answers safely and informatively rather than collapsing into generic refusal.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but real. The paper challenges the default assumption that unsafe data should simply be erased from the training pipeline. Instead, it treats such data as a high-density source of domain knowledge and moves the alignment burden to a lightweight control layer. That matters for data curation, continual pretraining, knowledge retention under alignment, and the broader question of how much useful capability is lost when safety is implemented as deletion. The contribution is better viewed as an alignment architecture with implications for pretrain/post-train interfaces, not as a new foundation-model training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, SafeMoE, uses a shared base model plus multiple domain-specific LoRA experts. Each expert is trained on unsafe data from a particular sensitive domain, so unsafe knowledge is stored in modular adapters rather than entangled across the whole model. This is the key design choice: if unsafe data is mixed directly into the full model, knowledge and harmful behavior are hard to disentangle later; if it is bottled into experts, the system can separate knowledge storage from knowledge access.

Training appears to proceed in two stages. First, domain-specific unsafe LoRAs are trained to capture detailed knowledge primitives. Second, a router is trained on a very small, highly curated safe-response dataset. At inference time, the router decides which experts to activate and how strongly, with the goal of composing responses that remain informative while avoiding actionable harmful details.

This differs from standard SFT/RLHF-style alignment, where the main model is globally pushed toward refusal or safe behavior. It also differs from a simple safety classifier that blocks outputs after generation. SafeMoE instead frames alignment as controlled access to specialized knowledge modules. Another important detail is the paper’s explicit definition of informativeness: avoiding blanket refusal while still providing relevant, helpful content without exposing harmful instructions. That makes the objective a structured safety–utility trade-off rather than pure toxicity suppression.

The method relies on two assumptions. First, unsafe knowledge can be decomposed into domain-local experts. Second, a small safe dataset is sufficient to learn when and how to use those experts. If either assumption breaks, the router becomes the main failure point.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical claim is that SafeMoE is both safer than unsafe baselines and more informative than standard alignment baselines that default to refusal. The most concrete experimental signal from the full text provided is the data efficiency claim: the router is trained with fewer than 800 curated safe examples, and the paper suggests the setup can be pushed down to around 100 examples in a more constrained regime. That is central to the paper’s argument, because it is trying to show that expensive safe supervision can be used for control rather than for re-teaching all relevant knowledge.

Evaluation is organized around two axes. One is safety: whether the model reveals harmful procedures or operational details. The other is informativeness: whether it gives explanations, alternatives, risk framing, or support-oriented guidance instead of a flat refusal. The paper also includes human annotation, and the human judgments reportedly agree with the automatic metrics: SafeMoE better matches the preference for safe-but-useful responses.

The material provided does not include the full benchmark table, model size, or exact gains against each baseline, so those numbers cannot be stated reliably here. What is clear is that the authors do not rely only on automated safety scores, which is important because refusal-heavy systems often look artificially strong under coarse safety metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to understand the paper’s central objection to safety-by-erasure. Then read the method overview and focus on two structural ideas: unsafe knowledge is isolated in LoRA experts, and safe behavior is enforced through a small-data router. Once those are clear, most of the paper follows naturally.

Three parts deserve attention. First, the motivating examples that distinguish unsafe answers, blanket refusals, and safe-informative answers; this is where the task definition is really set. Second, the router training setup and inference-time activation logic, because that is where the sample-efficiency claim lives. Third, the human evaluation protocol, since this kind of work can otherwise optimize for metrics while degrading actual usefulness.

A practical reading plan is 20–30 minutes: introduction, method figure, main results table, and human evaluation. If reading more deeply, the two questions worth probing are whether the experts truly capture separable knowledge rather than just unsafe style, and how robust the router is on out-of-distribution sensitive prompts.

recommendation.zh: 挑战了对齐必须丢弃危险数据的固有认知，SafeMoE的门控路由设计可给后训练对齐的数据利用提供新思路，重点看门控训练部分
recommendation.en: Challenges the inherent belief that unsafe data must be discarded during alignment; the SafeMoE gating design offers new ideas for post-pretrain alignment data utilization, focus on the gating training section

paper.title: MESA: Improving MoE Safety Alignment via Decentralized Expertise

summary.core_problem: MoE大模型存在安全稀疏性问题：安全能力集中在少数专家中，攻击者可通过操纵路由激活未对齐的专家，绕过安全防护；同时传统全参数对齐方法会破坏专家专业化特性、扰乱路由分布，带来安全提升与通用能力下降的两难问题。
summary.importance: 首次从架构感知的资源分配视角解决MoE安全对齐问题，提出的安全能力分散化思路，也为MoE预训练、持续训练中的能力分配、路由优化提供了参考，可避免全参数微调对已有专业能力的破坏。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MESA框架，包含两个协同模块：1）专家容量重分配：基于最优传输（OT）理论，通过带KL正则的Sinkhorn算法计算传输成本矩阵，选择最适合承载安全能力的专家群体，最小化安全提升与通用能力损失的权衡；2）动态路由精炼：训练时加入在线OT约束，引导路由将安全相关流量导向调整后的安全专家，同时保留原有通用任务的激活分布。
summary.experiments: 在DeepSeek-V2-Lite上测试：对抗越狱基准Strata的安全得分达90.90%，优于标准SFT（77.70%）、MoE专用方法SafeX（64.00%）以及之前领先的内容级方法Stair-DPO（83.60%）；通用能力上GSM8K得分66.11%，远高于标准SFT（16.15%）和Stair-DPO（15.54%），实现安全提升的同时无显著通用效用损失。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看引言部分的安全稀疏性问题定义，再了解两个核心模块的设计逻辑，重点关注最优传输在MoE专家分配中的应用方式，预计阅读时间20-25分钟；关注MoE架构对齐的研究者可深挖路由约束的实现细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者之一H.X.任职于阿里巴巴，参与Qwen3-30B-A3B的开发与评估工作。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE LLMs suffer from Safety Sparsity: safety capabilities are concentrated in a small subset of experts, leaving the model vulnerable to adversarial attacks that manipulate routing to activate unaligned experts. Conventional full-parameter alignment methods also disrupt expert specialization and routing distribution, creating an unavoidable trade-off between safety improvement and general utility degradation.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes the first architecture-aware resource allocation framework for MoE safety alignment. The paradigm of decentralized capability distribution across experts also provides insights for MoE pretraining and continual training, avoiding capability corruption caused by full-parameter fine-tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The MESA framework has two coordinated components. First, Expert Capacity Reallocation: based on Optimal Transport (OT) theory, it uses a KL-regularized Sinkhorn algorithm to compute a transport cost matrix, selecting the optimal expert group to absorb safety capabilities, minimizing the trade-off between safety gains and utility loss. Second, Dynamic Routing Refinement: it adds an online OT constraint during training to guide the router to direct safety-related traffic to the adapted safety experts, while preserving original activation patterns for general tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on DeepSeek-V2-Lite: it achieves 90.90% safety score on the challenging jailbreak benchmark Strata, outperforming standard SFT (77.70%), MoE-specific method SafeX (64.00%), and prior leading content-level method Stair-DPO (83.60%). On general utility, it reaches 66.11% on GSM8K, far exceeding standard SFT (16.15%) and Stair-DPO (15.54%), delivering safety improvement without meaningful utility loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the definition of Safety Sparsity, then review the design logic of the two core modules, with focus on the application of Optimal Transport for MoE expert allocation. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes. Researchers focused on MoE alignment can dig into implementation details of the routing constraint.
summary_en.authors_note: Author H.X. is employed by Alibaba, and participated in the development and evaluation of Qwen3-30B-A3B.

recommendation.zh: 探讨了MoE路由机制与安全对齐的相互作用，提出分散安全知识以缓解safety tax，对MoE的SFT/RLHF阶段如何设计路由策略有启发。
recommendation.en: Explores the interaction between MoE routing mechanisms and safety alignment, proposing to decentralize safety knowledge to mitigate the safety tax, providing insights for designing routing strategies during the SFT/RLHF phases of MoE.

paper.title: Understanding Safety-Sensitive Expert Behavior in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs rely on sparse, router-driven expert activation, yet how safety alignment interacts with routed expert specialization remains underexplored. A common intuition is that safety behavior may be controlled by routing harmful requests to distinct refusal-oriented experts. In this work, we provide empirical evidence for a different picture: routing patterns in aligned MoE LLMs are largely topic-driven, while safety behavior can be altered with little change to the model's

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 MoE LLM 的安全行为是否主要由 router 把有害请求导向“拒答专家”来实现。作者的结论是，aligned MoE 的路由更多由主题语义驱动，安全拒答可以在路由路径基本不变的情况下被改变。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 MoE 预训练和对齐都有参考价值。它说明 router 不一定是安全行为的主要控制面，至少在被测开源 MoE 上，专家的内部表征可能比路由选择更直接地承载安全相关行为。这对 MoE 训练有两个含义。第一，只靠观察路由分布，很可能低估局部专家参数对安全行为的影响。第二，安全对齐如果只约束 router 或只做输入级路由防御，可能无法覆盖专家内部的可塑性。对预训练研究员来说，这篇论文的价值在于把 MoE expert specialization 和 alignment behavior 放到同一个实验框架里分析，而不是只把专家看作容量扩展模块。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先做三组路由探针。第一，比较同一有害 prompt 下模型自然生成拒答 continuation 与 teacher-forced 合规 continuation 的路由差异。第二，测试对 benign prompt 加入拒答约束是否显著改变路由。第三，构造保留主题和表面结构、去除有害意图的 benign counterpart，用来分离 topic 与 harmful intent。三组结果共同指向：改变拒答/合规行为或安全意图时，路由变化小于改变主题时的变化。基于这个观察，作者提出 RASET，即 Router-Agnostic Safety-critical Expert Tuning。RASET 先计算每个 expert 对有害请求的 contrastive routing sensitivity：不是看有害样本上的 raw activation，而是减去 benign instruction 上的 activation，从而压低主题通用专家，突出更偏向有害请求处理的专家。随后只对这些被选中的 expert 做参数高效调优，冻结 router、共享组件和其他 expert。这个设计避免通过 router 干预把 token 导向不匹配专家，也更直接检验安全行为是否能通过少量 expert 表征修改被改变。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个开源 MoE backbone。RASET 在严格质量约束下达到 50.5% 的平均 ASR_hq，比最强 baseline 平均高 37.6 个百分点。参数更新量很小，只占模型参数的 0.12%–0.95%。同时，相比 router-manipulation baseline，RASET 在 TruthfulQA 和 MMLU 上保留了更好的 benign utility。论文还通过路由探针说明，安全相关行为变化并不伴随大规模 intrinsic routing shift；这使 RASET 的结果更像是 expert-level representation 的局部失效，而不是简单的路由劫持。需要注意的是，这类红队实验展示的是脆弱性和诊断信号，不应直接等同于真实部署中的攻击可行性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、三组 routing probe、RASET 的 expert selection 公式和主实验表，预计 40–60 分钟。重点看 contrastive routing-sensitivity criterion，因为它决定了方法不是选择“有害样本激活最多”的专家，而是选择相对 benign 样本更偏向有害处理的专家。另一个重点是 routing preservation 与 benign utility 的结果，它们决定 RASET 是否真的区别于 router-level attack。对 MoE 训练感兴趣的读者可以进一步看不同层、不同 expert 数量和不同 backbone 上的消融，判断安全敏感 expert 是否呈现层级或模型规模相关规律。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether safety behavior in aligned MoE LLMs is mainly implemented by routing harmful requests to refusal-specialized experts. Its empirical answer is different: routing is largely topic-driven, while refusal or compliance behavior can change with only small changes to the intrinsic routing path.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to MoE pretraining and alignment because it separates expert specialization from router control. The evidence suggests that routers in the evaluated aligned MoEs are not primarily organized around a refusal-versus-compliance axis. Safety-sensitive behavior can instead reside inside the representations of experts that are naturally activated by the topic. This matters for MoE training and auditing: routing statistics alone may miss localized safety vulnerabilities, and defenses that focus mainly on router manipulation may not constrain the expert-level degrees of freedom that posttraining leaves behind.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first run three routing probes. They compare native refusal continuations with teacher-forced compliant continuations for the same harmful prompts. They test whether refusal-enforced requests change the routing of benign prompts. They also create benign counterparts that preserve topic and surface form while removing unsafe intent, which separates topical specialization from harmful intent. In all three settings, routing changes induced by safety behavior or intent are smaller than changes induced by topic. Motivated by this, they introduce RASET, Router-Agnostic Safety-critical Expert Tuning. RASET identifies candidate experts using a contrastive routing-sensitivity score: activation on harmful instructions minus activation on benign instructions. This suppresses topic-general experts and highlights experts more specifically associated with harmful-request processing. It then applies parameter-efficient tuning only to the selected experts, while freezing the router, shared components, and all non-selected experts. The design directly tests whether localized expert representations can alter safety behavior without changing the model’s routing logic.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five open-weight MoE backbones. Under the most stringent quality-qualified criterion, RASET reaches 50.5% average ASR_hq and outperforms the strongest baseline by 37.6 percentage points on average. It updates only 0.12%–0.95% of model parameters. At the same time, it preserves benign utility better than router-manipulation baselines on TruthfulQA and MMLU. The routing probes show that safety behavior can change without a large intrinsic routing shift, supporting the claim that the failure mode is localized in expert representations rather than only in router steering. The results should be read as a diagnostic red-teaming study, not as a direct measurement of deployment risk.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim should cover the Introduction, the three routing probes, the RASET expert-selection criterion, and the main attack-utility tradeoff tables. Expected reading time is 40–60 minutes. The key technical detail is the contrastive routing score: selecting experts by harmful-minus-benign activation is more informative than selecting experts by raw harmful activation. The second important part is the evidence for routing preservation and benign utility retention, since that is what distinguishes RASET from router-level interventions. Readers working on MoE training should also inspect layer-wise and expert-count ablations if available, as these may reveal whether safety-sensitive experts concentrate in particular depths or vary by backbone.

recommendation.zh: 读路由分析部分就够；若结果稳，它会修正“MoE 安全=路由到拒答专家”的过度简化 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the routing analysis; if robust, it corrects the oversimplified prior that MoE safety equals routing harmful prompts to refusal experts.

paper.title: ReMoE: Boosting Expert Reuse through Router Fine-Tuning in Memory-Constrained MoE LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models sparsely activate only a subset of experts per token, reducing activated computation while maintaining high model capacity. However, in memory-constrained inference scenarios, only a small set of experts can be cached. Experts not in the cache must be fetched from slow external storage (e.g., UFS), leading to frequent evictions and substantial I/O overhead.   We propose ReMoE, a router fine-tuning framework designed to boost token-wise expert reuse. R

summary.core_problem: MoE大模型在内存受限的边缘/端侧推理场景下，显存无法容纳全部专家权重，原生训练的路由为了负载均衡会分散token到不同专家，导致解码过程中频繁从外部存储加载专家，产生极高的I/O开销；现有系统级缓存/预取方案没有解决上游路由行为与缓存局部性不匹配的根本问题。
summary.importance: 属于MoE部署与训练-部署对齐方向，通过轻量路由微调来适配内存约束，无需修改模型架构、推理内核或硬件，可直接集成到现有MoE推理栈中，为端侧大模型的MoE架构落地提供了低成本方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReMoE路由微调框架，包含两个互补的训练目标：1）时间局部性损失，鼓励相邻token的路由专家集合重叠，提升短期重用率；2）Trust-KL损失，将更新后的路由分布软锚定到预训练路由，限制分布漂移避免效果下降。通过调整路由输出的时序稳定性，将碎片化的路由序列转换为更适合缓存的连续序列。
summary.experiments: 在DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B上，相邻token的专家重叠率分别提升26.4%和27.2%；离线缓存分析显示唯一请求命中率（uHR）提升、唯一未命中数（#uMiss）下降；实际系统测试中，vLLM GPU-CPU专家卸载场景下吞吐量提升8.4%、每token时延降低4.5%；Jetson Orin NX边缘设备上，ShareGPT、GSM8K、HumanEval数据集的解码时延降低43.6-49.8%，对应1.77-1.99倍的解码加速。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第2节的MoE卸载局部性缺口分析、第3节的两个损失函数设计，泛读第4节的边缘设备实际系统测试结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE LLMs cannot fit all expert weights in fast memory under memory-constrained edge/on-device inference scenarios. MoE routers are originally trained with load-balancing objectives that disperse tokens across experts, leading to frequent expert loads from slow external storage during decoding and high I/O overhead. Existing system-level caching/prefetching solutions do not address the root mismatch between upstream routing behavior and cache locality.
summary_en.importance: This work addresses the training-deployment alignment problem for MoE inference. The lightweight router fine-tuning approach requires no changes to model architecture, inference kernels or hardware, and can be directly integrated into existing MoE serving stacks, providing a low-cost solution for MoE deployment on edge devices.
summary_en.technical_approach: The ReMoE framework uses two complementary fine-tuning objectives for the router: 1) Temporal locality loss, which encourages overlap between expert sets selected for adjacent tokens to improve short-horizon reuse; 2) Trust-KL loss, which softly anchors the updated routing distribution to the pretrained router to limit distribution drift and preserve model quality. The method shapes fragmented routing traces into cache-friendly consecutive sequences without inference-time overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, ReMoE improves adjacent-step expert overlap by 26.4% and 27.2% respectively. Offline trace-driven cache analysis shows higher unique hit rate (uHR) and lower number of unique misses (#uMiss) across cache sizes and replacement policies. Real-system evaluations show 8.4% higher throughput and 4.5% lower time per output token (TPOT) under vLLM GPU-CPU expert offloading. On Jetson Orin NX edge devices, ReMoE reduces TPOT by 43.6-49.8% across ShareGPT, GSM8K and HumanEval, corresponding to 1.77-1.99x decoding speedup.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 2 for the locality gap analysis of MoE offloading and Section 3 for the design of the two training objectives. Skim the edge device real-system test results in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 通过微调 Router 增加时间局部性来缓解 MoE 推理的 I/O 瓶颈，思路很实用，对端侧 MoE 部署和 Router 设计有启发，值得看其微调 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Alleviating MoE inference I/O bottlenecks by fine-tuning the Router to increase temporal locality is a practical idea, inspiring for edge MoE deployment and Router design; worth checking its fine-tuning loss design.

paper.title: VidPrism: Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts for Image-to-Video Transfer
paper.abstract: With the rapid development of pre-training technologies, adapting large-scale Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for video understanding \emph{\ie} image-to-video transfer learning has become a dominant paradigm. To achieve superior performance, it raises as an effective strategy among recent advances to employ Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to enhance VLMs' temporal modeling capabilities. However, conventional MoE designs suffer from expert homogenization, where all experts act as identical generalists, i

summary.core_problem: 图像 VLM 迁移到视频理解时，普通 temporal MoE 容易出现专家同质化，不能有效分工建模空间语义和时间动态。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频 VLM 迁移中的 MoE 结构改进。它不是 LLM 基座训练论文，但对多模态 MoE 的专家分工、路由输入设计和视频时间建模有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: VidPrism 提出 heterogeneous temporal MoE，为不同专家指定不同功能角色，覆盖空间理解到时间建模。它还引入 content-aware multi-rate sampling，根据内容动态产生不同帧率或时间粒度的视频流，把合适的信息送入对应专家，减少所有专家学习相同视频统计的倾向。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法用于 image-to-video transfer learning，并与常规 MoE 设计比较，目标是提升视频理解性能。具体使用的 VLM backbone、专家数量、视频数据集、baseline 和提升幅度未在摘要中给出，需要查正文。

summary_en.core_problem: When image VLMs are transferred to video understanding, standard temporal MoE modules can collapse into homogeneous experts that fail to separate spatial semantics from temporal dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an MoE design for video VLM transfer. It is not an LLM pretraining result, but it offers a useful reference point for expert specialization, routing inputs, and temporal modeling in multimodal MoE systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: VidPrism proposes a heterogeneous temporal MoE where experts are assigned different functional roles, ranging from spatial understanding to temporal modeling. A content-aware multi-rate sampling module dynamically creates video streams at different temporal granularities and feeds them to the appropriate specialists.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for image-to-video transfer learning and compares it against conventional MoE designs for video understanding. Backbone details, expert counts, datasets, baselines, and exact gains are not available in the abstract and require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态 MoE 备查即可；若正文没有路由熵和专家功能可视化，异构专家很可能只是工程命名。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a multimodal-MoE reference; without routing entropy and expert-role evidence, the heterogeneous experts may just be engineering labels.

paper.title: FPMoE: A Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Approach to Functional Code Generation
paper.abstract: Despite rapid progress in LLM-based code generation, existing models are predominantly trained on imperative languages, leaving functional programming languages (FPLs) such as Haskell, OCaml, and Scala chronically underexplored, with even frontier models performing substantially worse on FPLs. Fine-tuning is a natural remedy, but our experiments show that per-language fine-tuning fails to capture shared functional abstractions, while merged multi-language fine-tuning introduces cross-language in

summary.core_problem: 函数式语言如 Haskell、OCaml、Scala 在代码生成模型中训练不足，普通单语言微调和多语言混合微调分别面临共享抽象缺失与跨语言干扰。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向小众但结构性很强的代码语言提出稀疏 MoE 适配方案；对预训练研究员的价值在于观察专家路由能否缓解多域代码数据的负迁移，而不是代码能力本身。
summary.technical_approach: FPMoE 使用轻量级稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 架构，为 Haskell、OCaml、Scala 各设置语言专属 routed expert，同时加入 shared expert 捕捉 monadic reasoning、type-directed programming 等跨语言函数式抽象。设计目标是在保留共享模式的同时减少语言间干扰。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数规模、训练 token 数、基线模型名称或具体指标。作者声称相较单语言微调和合并多语言微调，FPMoE 同时缓解共享抽象不足和跨语言干扰，并改善函数式代码生成表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets functional programming languages such as Haskell, OCaml, and Scala, where code LMs remain weak and standard fine-tuning either misses shared abstractions or introduces cross-language interference.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a sparse MoE adaptation for a narrow but structurally interesting code domain. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is about expert routing under multi-domain code interference, not the application itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: FPMoE uses a lightweight sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with one routed expert per language and a shared expert intended to capture functional abstractions such as monadic reasoning and type-directed programming. The design tries to preserve cross-language structure while isolating language-specific interference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter count, training-token scale, baseline names, or exact metrics. It claims that FPMoE improves over per-language fine-tuning and merged multilingual fine-tuning by addressing both missing shared abstractions and cross-language interference.

recommendation.zh: 作为 MoE 缓解代码多域干扰的小样本案例即可；若无路由负载和专家专化分析，不必深读。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a small case study of MoE for multi-domain code interference; without routing-load and expert-specialization analysis, do not read deeply.

paper.title: Multi-Agent Systems are Mixtures of Experts: Who Becomes an Influencer?
paper.abstract: The effectiveness of multi-agent LLM deliberation depends not only on the agents' individual predictions, but also on how they communicate and collaborate. We study this mechanism through the lens of Friedkin-Johnsen (FJ) opinion dynamics, a tractable model for analyzing stubbornness, influence, and opinion change in multi-agent systems that captures empirically observed deliberation patterns. We show that the FJ parameters are input-dependent, turning multi-agent deliberation into a mixture of

summary.core_problem: 解释多智能体 LLM 协作为什么有时优于单智能体或静态集成，以及谁会在讨论中获得更大影响力。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent 机制分析：把多智能体 deliberation 写成输入依赖的 Mixture-of-Experts，有助于理解路由、影响力和能力估计，但对预训练的直接作用较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 用 Friedkin-Johnsen 意见动力学建模多智能体交互，把 agent 的固执度、影响力和观点更新参数视为输入依赖量；据此将 deliberation 解释为一种隐式 MoE，并分析影响力形成的可观测代理变量，如自评置信度、他评置信度和初始一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模或数据集细节。核心实验应是比较单智能体、静态集成和多智能体 deliberation，并检验不同影响力代理变量与最终性能的关系。更像分析框架而非大规模系统实证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why multi-agent LLM deliberation can outperform a single agent or static ensembles, and which agents become influential during discussion.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-mechanism paper. Framing deliberation as an input-dependent mixture of experts is conceptually useful for routing and competence estimation, though only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It uses Friedkin-Johnsen opinion dynamics to model stubbornness, influence, and opinion updates in multi-agent interaction. The key move is to treat these parameters as input-dependent, turning deliberation into an implicit MoE, and then study observable proxies for competence such as self-confidence, perceived confidence, and initial agreement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or benchmark details. The empirical focus appears to be comparisons among single-agent, static ensemble, and deliberative multi-agent setups, plus analysis of how influence proxies correlate with outcomes.

recommendation.zh: 把 multi-agent 解释成 input-dependent MoE 这个视角有点意思，但更像分析框架；预训练研究员读摘要和方法设定就够了。
recommendation.en: The input-dependent MoE lens for multi-agent deliberation is neat, but this is mostly an analysis frame; for pretraining folks, the abstract and setup are enough.

paper.title: Dynamic Mixture of Latent Memories for Self-Evolving Agents
paper.abstract: Achieving self-evolution in intelligent agents requires the continual accumulation of new knowledge across changing task sequences without forgetting previously acquired abilities. Existing approaches either internalize knowledge by updating model parameters, which induces catastrophic forgetting, or rely on external memory, which fails to genuinely enhance the model's intrinsic capabilities. We propose MoLEM, a generative mixture of latent memory framework based on a dynamic mixture-of-experts

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 agent 在连续任务序列中如何积累经验，同时避免遗忘。它不更新主干 LLM，而是希望把新任务经验写入可训练的 latent memory 模块，让冻结的推理模型在后续推理时直接使用这些连续表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近 post-train / agent memory / continual learning 接口问题。值得泛读的点在于：它把“持续学习”从参数更新转到 latent memory 更新，并用动态 MoE 做容量扩展和任务隔离。这对研究 continual pretrain、adapter memory、非参数外部记忆与参数记忆之间的中间形态有参考意义。它也提醒一个实际问题：冻结 backbone 并不等于没有遗忘，若 latent memory 生成器共享参数，仍然会发生跨任务覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: MoLEM 使用动态 mixture-of-experts 作为 latent memory 生成器。多个 expert 被看作独立的记忆载体，每个 expert 生成一段连续 latent memory；router 通过 key-query matching 选择并加权相关 experts；聚合后的 latent memory 被注入到 LLM 的推理过程中。主干 reasoner 参数全程冻结，只训练 MoE memory 模块。论文还引入 task-ID-free 的 domain-aware routing：每个训练阶段配一个轻量 autoencoder，推理时用输入在各阶段 autoencoder 上的 reconstruction error 选择最匹配的 routing group；如果输入不匹配任何阶段，则回退到原始预训练模型，作为 OOD 保护。latent memory 的触发位置由 delimiter token 控制，例如逗号、句号等位置生成连续记忆序列。这和纯 retrieval memory 的区别是：检索方法只是把文本上下文塞回 prompt；MoLEM 试图学习一个可复用的内部连续表示。它和直接 SFT / GRPO 的区别是：不改 backbone，因此减少对原始能力的破坏。
summary.experiments: 实验设置是 continual learning，任务序列覆盖 math、science、code。每个训练阶段结束后，在对应测试集上评估新任务学习和旧任务保持。完整任务序列结束后，MoLEM 相比 Vanilla pretrained baseline 的平均准确率提升 10.40%。论文强调，对比方法在不同训练顺序下不能稳定超过 vanilla baseline，说明直接参数更新或普通记忆方法在任务顺序变化时稳定性较弱。可用数字主要是平均准确率提升；参数量、expert 数量、训练 token 规模等关键信息在给定内容中无法确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分的三块：latent memory 如何生成和注入、MoE router 的 key-query matching、stage-wise autoencoder 如何做无 task ID 的路由选择。实验部分优先看不同任务顺序下的平均准确率和遗忘曲线，而不是只看最终分数。若关心 continual pretrain，可以重点比较它和 adapter tuning、LoRA continual learning、RAG memory 的边界：MoLEM 的优势来自冻结 backbone 和专家隔离，但代价是新增推理模块、路由错误风险，以及 latent memory 是否真正泛化到新组合任务仍需更强验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses continual self-evolution for LLM agents: how an agent can acquire experience over a sequence of changing tasks without overwriting previously acquired skills. The proposed answer is to keep the base reasoner frozen and store new experience in trainable latent-memory modules that are injected into the reasoning process.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the interface between post-training, agent memory, and continual learning. Its useful idea is to move continual adaptation away from backbone parameter updates and toward expandable latent memory. This gives a concrete middle ground between parametric fine-tuning and external retrieval: the memory is learned and internal to the computation, but the pretrained backbone remains unchanged.
summary_en.technical_approach: MoLEM builds a generative latent-memory module on top of a dynamic MoE structure. Each expert acts as an independent latent-memory carrier. A router performs key-query matching, selects and weights relevant experts, and aggregates their generated latent memories. The aggregated continuous memory is then injected into the frozen reasoner during generation. The method also uses task-ID-free domain routing. Each training stage has a lightweight autoencoder; at inference time, the system selects the routing group with the lowest reconstruction error. If no stage matches well, the input falls back to the pretrained model, which is used as an OOD safety path. Latent memory generation is activated around delimiter tokens, following prior latent-memory approaches such as MemGen-style designs.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use continual-learning task sequences spanning math, science, and code. After each stage, the model is evaluated on the corresponding test sets to measure both new-task acquisition and competence preservation. After the full sequence, MoLEM improves average accuracy by 10.40% over the vanilla pretrained baseline. The paper reports that competing methods do not consistently exceed the vanilla baseline under different task orders, which suggests sensitivity to interference and task ordering. Details such as the exact number of experts, trainable parameter count, and training scale are not available in the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, around 20–30 minutes. Focus on the latent-memory injection mechanism, the MoE router, and the stage-wise autoencoder routing design. In the experiments, the important plots are the per-stage continual-learning curves and the results under different task orders. For pretraining researchers, the useful question is not whether this is a stronger agent method, but whether expandable latent modules can provide a cleaner continual-adaptation interface than LoRA-style parameter updates or plain retrieval.

recommendation.zh: 只读方法图和 continual ablation；冻结基座加可路由 latent memory 是干净设定，但别把它等同于真参数内化。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and continual ablations; frozen-base routed latent memory is a clean setup, but do not equate it with true parameter internalization.
