paper.title: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing in Visual Diffusion Transformers:Diagnosis, Boundary Calibration and Evolutionary Roadmap from Routing Collapse to Selective Deadlock
paper.abstract: This paper systematically diagnoses the training failure modes of Token-Choice sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) on video Diffusion Transformers. Starting from a pretrained dense model of about 5 billion parameters, we convert it into an MoE architecture following three laws: routed experts exactly clone the original FFN weights, shared experts are initialized to zero for verification and then to extremely small non-zero noise for actual training, while only the gating networks start from random i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 Token-Choice 稀疏 MoE 放到视频 Diffusion Transformer 后为什么容易失效。核心问题是路由器在视觉扩散模型里并不会自然形成类似语言 MoE 的专家分工，而是会出现 routing collapse、global deadlock 和 selective deadlock 等训练动态问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 MoE 训练稳定性和跨模态扩展。语言模型里的 MoE 假设，依赖离散且语义密度较高的 token；视频 DiT 的视觉 patch token 冗余更强，还受扩散 timestep、空间结构和多任务条件影响。论文的价值在于把“MoE 在视觉生成里收益有限”拆成可观测的路由动态问题，而不是只报告最终生成质量。它对多模态基座、视频生成基座和 MoE 架构迁移有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从一个预训练 dense 视频生成模型出发，将 FFN 转成 MoE。实验设置包括：routed experts 直接从原 dense FFN 进行 1:1 权重克隆；shared experts 在验证阶段可置零以保证输出等价，训练阶段用极小非零噪声初始化，例如 1e-4；router 从随机初始化开始学习。这个设置的目的，是尽量排除专家初始能力差异，让失效主要暴露在路由学习本身。论文比较了从 linear router 到 cross-attention router 的结构演进，并提出若干诊断概念：global deadlock 指路由整体塌到少数专家；selective deadlock 指全局塌缩缓解后，仍有部分层长期退化为单专家使用；U-shaped deadlock distribution 指死锁层集中在浅层视觉处理层和深层语义整合层，中间层更平衡。作者还提出 functional redundancy hypothesis，把部分死锁解释为视觉 token 冗余和层功能分工下的一种阶段性资源分配，而不完全是优化失败。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Kiwi-Edit 设置，包含 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 视频扩散 backbone 和 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 多模态 encoder，总规模约 8B；dense 视频生成 backbone 约 5B。作者在 9-in-1 多任务视频生成场景中进行诊断。论文提到对 30 层网络、超过 6500 万 token 的时序数据进行层级分析，并在 5000 step、超过 34 亿 token 的路由决策轨迹上观察训练动态。关键现象包括：即使提高 auxiliary loss，也仍有约三分之一层退化为单专家使用；死锁并非均匀分布，而是呈浅层和深层更严重的 U 形分布；更强的 router 设计可以缓解全局死锁，但会暴露 selective deadlock 这类更局部、更稳定的退化模式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 40 分钟。优先看实验设置，确认 dense-to-MoE 转换、专家克隆、shared expert 初始化和 router 初始化是否足够控制变量。然后看 failure mode 的定义和对应曲线，尤其是 global deadlock、selective deadlock、U-shaped layer distribution。若时间有限，跳过生成样例，重点读路由负载、层级分布、auxiliary loss 消融和 router 结构对比。值得深挖的是：selective deadlock 到底是视觉 token 冗余导致的合理稀疏化，还是 auxiliary objective 与 diffusion loss 不匹配造成的优化偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why Token-Choice sparse MoE often fails when inserted into video Diffusion Transformers. The central issue is that visual diffusion models do not automatically develop the kind of expert specialization observed in language MoEs; instead, their routers can enter routing collapse, global deadlock, or selective deadlock.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to pretraining through MoE stability and cross-modal scaling. Language MoE success relies on discrete, semantically dense tokens, while video DiT tokens are spatially redundant and are affected by diffusion timesteps, spatial structure, and multi-task conditioning. The useful part is the diagnostic framing: limited gains from visual MoE are traced to measurable routing dynamics rather than treated as a vague architecture failure. This matters for multimodal foundation models, video generation backbones, and attempts to transfer LLM MoE recipes to visual generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors start from a pretrained dense video generation model and convert its FFN blocks into MoE modules. Routed experts are cloned one-to-one from the original dense FFN weights. Shared experts are zero-initialized for verification, to preserve output equivalence, and initialized with tiny non-zero noise such as 1e-4 for training. Routers are randomly initialized and trained from scratch. This controlled setup is designed to expose routing failures rather than expert-capacity differences. The paper compares an architectural progression from linear routers to cross-attention routers and defines several failure modes. Global deadlock refers to broad collapse into a small number of experts. Selective deadlock appears after global collapse is reduced, where a subset of layers still degenerates into near single-expert usage. The reported U-shaped deadlock distribution means deadlocked layers concentrate in shallow visual-processing layers and deep semantic-integration layers, while middle layers remain more balanced. The functional redundancy hypothesis interprets some deadlock as phased resource allocation under visual-token redundancy, rather than pure optimizer failure.
summary_en.experiments: The diagnostic setup is based on Kiwi-Edit, using a Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video diffusion backbone and a Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct multimodal encoder, for roughly 8B total parameters; the dense video backbone is about 5B. Experiments are conducted in a 9-in-1 multi-task video generation setting. The paper reports layerwise temporal analysis on a 30-layer network with more than 65 million tokens, and routing-decision traces over 5,000 steps and more than 3.4 billion tokens. Key observations include: roughly one third of layers can collapse into single-expert usage even when the auxiliary loss is increased; deadlock is not uniformly distributed but follows a shallow-and-deep U-shaped pattern; stronger router designs reduce global deadlock but reveal more local and persistent selective deadlock.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 40 minutes. Start with the dense-to-MoE conversion details, especially expert cloning, shared-expert initialization, and router initialization, because these choices determine whether the diagnosis is well controlled. Then read the definitions and plots for global deadlock, selective deadlock, and the U-shaped layer distribution. If time is limited, skip qualitative generation examples and focus on routing load, layerwise distribution, auxiliary-loss ablations, and router-architecture comparisons. The main question worth probing is whether selective deadlock reflects a reasonable sparsification caused by visual-token redundancy, or an optimization artifact caused by mismatch between the auxiliary routing objective and the diffusion training loss.

recommendation.zh: 视频扩散Transformer中MoE路由失效的系统诊断，5层失效模式对LLM MoE也有类比参考价值，尤其MLP路由器选择性死lock现象值得注意。只看§3-4诊断部分即可。
recommendation.en: Systematic diagnosis of MoE routing failures in video diffusion Transformers. The 5 failure modes (especially MLP router selective deadlock) have analogical value for LLM MoE. Read only §3-4 diagnosis.

paper.title: $ϕ$-Balancing for Mixture-of-Experts Training
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models rely on balanced expert utilization to fully realize their scalability. However, existing load-balancing methods are largely heuristic and operate on noisy mini-batch assignment statistics, introducing bias relative to population-level objectives. We propose $φ$-balancing, a principled framework that directly targets population-level expert balance by minimizing a strictly convex, symmetric, and differentiable potential of the expected routing distribution. Using

summary.core_problem: 现有MoE预训练的负载均衡方法大多为启发式设计，基于单批次噪声较大的路由统计计算，没有对齐全量数据分布下的全局专家均衡目标，会引入系统性偏差，最终导致专家利用率不均、模型容量无法充分发挥、训练性能下降。
summary.importance: MoE是当前大模型规模化的核心路线之一，负载均衡效果直接决定MoE的容量利用率和训练稳定性。这项工作提出了首个有严格凸优化理论支撑的全局负载均衡框架，不需要引入会干扰主任务梯度的辅助损失，计算开销可忽略，能直接落地到现有大规模MoE预训练流程，解决了MoE领域长期存在的均衡方法无理论依据、存在统计偏差的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将负载均衡问题建模为最小化作用于全局平均路由分布的严格凸、对称、可微势函数ϕ，直接对齐全局均衡目标；随后通过凸对偶推导得到等价的最小-最大公式，采用在线镜像下降求解，最终得到基于指数移动平均（EMA）的路由调整算法，仅需维护路由概率的EMA值，额外计算开销可忽略。框架支持多种势函数选择，实验验证负熵函数实际效果最优。与现有方法的核心区别：一是跟踪全局期望路由分布而非依赖单批次统计，消除了小批次噪声带来的偏差；二是不需要引入Switch式的辅助损失，避免辅助损失的梯度干扰主任务学习；三是所有设计有严格的理论支撑，而非启发式规则。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖大规模预训练和下游微调两个阶段：预训练阶段采用Gemma架构的MoE变体，在控制计算预算的条件下系统缩放激活参数量、专家数量、路由粒度，ϕ-balancing在所有配置下的预训练性能均超过ST-MoE；下游微调阶段基于DeepSeek等指令微调MoE骨干，采用LoRA在7个基准上测试，所有实验累计消耗约4万NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU小时。消融实验验证了EMA负载跟踪机制、负熵势函数、EMA衰减率的最优配置，方法整体开销与现有负载均衡方案相比可忽略。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第3章ϕ-balancing的理论推导部分，重点理解凸对偶转换和镜像下降推导在线算法的过程，以及势函数ϕ的选择逻辑；第4章的消融实验部分，重点关注EMA衰减率、势函数选择对性能的影响，以及与ST-MoE、无损失均衡方法的头对头对比；附录的算法实现细节可直接复用进现有MoE训练框架。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing load balancing methods for MoE pretraining are mostly heuristic, designed based on noisy per-mini-batch routing statistics. They are not aligned with the global expert balancing objective under the full data distribution, introducing systematic bias that leads to uneven expert utilization, underused model capacity, and degraded training performance.
summary_en.importance: MoE is one of the core paradigms for scaling large language models, and load balancing directly determines MoE capacity utilization and training stability. This work proposes the first theoretically grounded global load balancing framework for MoE training backed by convex optimization. It does not introduce auxiliary losses that interfere with main task gradients, has negligible computational overhead, and can be directly integrated into existing large-scale MoE pretraining pipelines, resolving the long-standing issue of heuristic, biased balancing methods in MoE training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework formulates load balancing as the minimization of a strictly convex, symmetric, differentiable potential function φ applied to the population mean routing distribution, directly targeting global balancing objectives. It then derives an equivalent min-max formulation via convex duality, and solves the resulting problem with online mirror descent to obtain an EMA-based routing adjustment algorithm that only maintains the exponential moving average of routing probabilities with negligible overhead. Multiple potential functions are supported, with negative entropy verified as the most effective in practice. Key differences from existing methods: first, it tracks the global expected routing distribution instead of relying on per-batch statistics, eliminating bias from mini-batch noise; second, it does not require Switch-style auxiliary losses, avoiding gradient interference with main task learning; third, all designs are backed by rigorous theory instead of heuristic rules.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover both large-scale pretraining and downstream fine-tuning stages. For pretraining, MoE variants of the Gemma architecture are tested, with systematic scaling of active parameter count, expert count, and routing granularity under controlled compute budgets. φ-balancing outperforms ST-MoE across all configurations. For downstream fine-tuning, instruction-tuned MoE backbones including DeepSeek are evaluated with LoRA on 7 benchmarks. Total compute for all experiments reaches approximately 40,000 NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU hours. Ablation studies verify the optimal configuration of EMA load tracking, negative entropy potential function, and EMA decay rate, with negligible overhead compared to existing methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the theoretical derivation of φ-balancing, specifically the convex duality transformation and the process of deriving the online algorithm via mirror descent, as well as the logic for selecting the potential function φ. For Section 4, pay attention to ablation results on EMA decay rate, potential function selection, and head-to-head comparisons with ST-MoE and loss-free balancing. Implementation details in the appendix can be directly reused in existing MoE training frameworks.

recommendation.zh: 改变MoE负载均衡的设计范式，算法简洁开销可忽略，应立刻在内部MoE预训练中做消融验证
recommendation.en: Shifts MoE load balancing design paradigm, algorithm is simple with negligible overhead, run internal ablation immediately for MoE pretraining

paper.title: Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents Incentivizes Swarm Intelligence of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have catalyzed the development of multi-agent systems (MAS) for complex reasoning tasks. However, existing MAS typically rely on pre-defined or pre-compiled communication topologies, which limits their flexibility and adaptability to dynamic task requirements. In this work, we propose Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA), a self-evolving multi-agent framework that enables elastic and adaptive agent collaboration during inference. Instead of stat

summary.core_problem: 现有多智能体系统依赖预定义或预编译的通信拓扑，推理过程中无法动态适配任务变化需求，容易出现解决方案质量不足或token冗余消耗的问题
summary.importance: 可微分路由加测试时自监督的设计思路可迁移到LLM预训练中MoE层的动态路由优化，弹性多智能体协同范式也为RL预训练的多任务、多模态协同训练提供参考
summary.technical_approach: 提出可微分混合智能体（DMoA）框架，每个推理步基于上下文动态路由激活候选智能体，无需预编译拓扑结构；路由机制参考MoE的可微分门控设计，采用智能体执行后的预测熵作为自监督信号优化，支持测试时训练
summary.experiments: 在9个多场景基准上取得领先性能，相比固定拓扑的MoA，动态路由减少约15%的token消耗，同时推理精度在不同任务上提升2%~8%，验证了框架的弹性、鲁棒性和集成能力
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看引言中静态与动态拓扑的对比示意图、路由机制设计章节，以及实验部分的token效率与性能的tradeoff数据，预计阅读时间15分钟
summary.authors_note: 匿名提交，无公开作者机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on pre-defined or pre-compiled communication topologies, which fail to dynamically adapt to changing task demands during inference, leading to either insufficient solution quality or redundant token consumption
summary_en.importance: The differentiable routing plus test-time self-supervision design can be transferred to dynamic routing optimization for MoE layers in LLM pre-training, and the elastic multi-agent collaboration paradigm also provides reference for multi-task and multi-modal collaborative training in RL pre-training
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA) framework, which dynamically routes and activates candidate agents at each reasoning step without pre-compiled topologies. The routing mechanism draws on the differentiable gating design of MoE, uses prediction entropy after agent execution as self-supervised optimization signal, and supports test-time training
summary_en.experiments: Deliver leading performance on 9 multi-scenario benchmarks. Compared with fixed-topology MoA, dynamic routing reduces token consumption by around 15% while improving inference accuracy by 2%~8% across different tasks, verifying the framework's elasticity, robustness and ensembling capability
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the comparison diagram of static and dynamic topologies in introduction, the routing mechanism design section, and the token efficiency vs performance tradeoff results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes
summary_en.authors_note: Anonymous submission, no public author or affiliation information available

recommendation.zh: 可微动态路由的梯度回传设计对MoE预训练的路由模块优化有参考意义，重点看路由机制的核心实现。
recommendation.en: The gradient backpropagation design of differentiable dynamic routing is informative for MoE routing module optimization in pre-training; focus on the core implementation of the routing mechanism.

paper.title: BEAM: Binary Expert Activation Masking for Dynamic Routing in MoE
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enhance the efficiency of large language models by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, standard MoE employs a fixed Top-K routing strategy, leading to redundant computation and suboptimal inference latency. Existing acceleration methods either require costly retraining with architectural changes or suffer from severe performance drop at high sparsity due to train-inference mismatch. To address these limitations, we propose BEAM (Binary E

summary.core_problem: MoE模型传统固定Top-K路由不区分token复杂度，导致简单token产生冗余计算；现有动态路由方法要么存在专家选择、负载均衡、稀疏控制的梯度冲突，要么需要改动架构重训，或在高稀疏度下性能损失严重，无法兼顾训练兼容性、推理效率和模型效果。
summary.importance: 提出了解耦专家选择与稀疏控制的MoE动态路由思路，方案轻量可插拔，可直接用于MoE预训练后的推理优化，也可为训练阶段的动态稀疏路由设计提供依据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BEAM（二元专家激活掩码）框架，在原有主路由生成Top-K候选专家的基础上，新增一个轻量掩码路由，通过可训练二元掩码从Top-K候选中进一步裁剪冗余专家。用直通估计器（STE）传递二元掩码的梯度，辅以辅助正则损失鼓励稀疏。该设计解耦了主路由的专家选择、负载均衡功能与掩码路由的稀疏度控制功能，避免梯度冲突。BEAM可通过自定义CUDA内核集成到vLLM，仅需少量代码修改即可部署。
summary.experiments: 在高稀疏度下保留98%以上的模型性能，MoE层FLOPs最高减少85%，吞吐量提升1.4倍，解码速度提升2.5倍。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点：引言中对现有三类动态路由缺陷的分析、BEAM的解耦设计思路、实验部分的稀疏度-性能权衡结果。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional fixed Top-K routing in MoE models ignores token-level complexity, causing redundant computation for simple tokens. Existing dynamic routing methods either suffer from gradient conflicts between expert selection, load balancing and sparsity control, require architectural changes and full retraining, or incur severe performance degradation at high sparsity, failing to balance training compatibility, inference efficiency and model quality.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a decoupled design for MoE dynamic routing that separates expert selection and sparsity control. The lightweight, plug-and-play solution can be directly applied to post-pretraining inference optimization of MoE models, and provides reference for dynamic sparse routing design during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BEAM (Binary Expert Activation Masking), a dynamic routing framework that adds a lightweight mask router on top of the standard primary router. The primary router first generates Top-K candidate experts, then the mask router produces trainable binary masks to prune redundant experts from the candidate set. Gradients for the binary mask are propagated via the straight-through estimator (STE), with an auxiliary regularization loss to encourage sparsity. This design decouples the primary router's responsibilities of expert selection and load balancing from the mask router's sparsity control, eliminating gradient conflicts. BEAM can be integrated into vLLM with minimal code changes and a custom CUDA kernel for production deployment.
summary_en.experiments: Preserves over 98% of model performance at high sparsity, reduces MoE layer FLOPs by up to 85%, delivers 1.4× higher throughput and 2.5× faster decoding speed.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: focus on the introduction's analysis of limitations of three existing dynamic routing categories, BEAM's decoupled design, and the sparsity-performance tradeoff results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: MoE动态路由的新尝试，用二值掩码替代Top-K，关注其正则化损失设计和端到端训练的稳定性，对MoE架构优化有启发。
recommendation.en: A new attempt at dynamic routing in MoE, replacing Top-K with binary masks. Focus on its regularization loss design and end-to-end training stability, inspiring for MoE architecture optimization.

paper.title: RQ-MoE: Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts for Efficient Input-Dependent Vector Compression
paper.abstract: Vector quantization is a fundamental tool for compressing high-dimensional embeddings, yet existing multi-codebook methods rely on static codebooks that limit expressiveness under heterogeneous data geometry. While recent dynamic quantizers like QINCo adapt codebooks to individual inputs and improve expressiveness, their strict sequential dependencies create decoding bottlenecks. We propose Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts (RQ-MoE), a framework combining a two-level MoE with dual-str

summary.core_problem: 如何在保持高压缩率/低失真的同时，让向量量化具备输入自适应能力且解码可并行，避免顺序残差量化的瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对embedding/latent压缩、向量tokenizer、以及推理侧向量检索/缓存压缩有潜在借鉴；但不直接触及LLM预训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RQ-MoE：两层MoE + 双流量化，实现“动态构造codebook”的输入依赖量化，并通过将“指令/路由”与“量化”解耦来支持并行解码；理论上把标准Residual Quantization与QINCo视为其受限特例，并给出expert维度设置指导。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多项向量量化实验上达到SOTA或持平，并强调相对QINCo减少顺序依赖带来的解码瓶颈；未在摘要中给出数据集、码率-失真曲线、吞吐/延迟数字与关键消融。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve input-adaptive vector quantization with high fidelity while enabling parallel decoding, avoiding the sequential bottleneck of residual quantizers like QINCo.
summary_en.importance: Potentially useful for embedding/latent compression and vector tokenizers (and some inference-side compression), though it does not directly change LLM pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: RQ-MoE: a two-level MoE with dual-stream quantization to build input-dependent codebooks; decouples instruction/routing from quantization to allow parallel decoding. Shows standard Residual Quantization and QINCo as constrained special cases and derives a guideline for expert dimensionality.
summary_en.experiments: Claims SOTA or on-par performance on vector quantization benchmarks and improved decoding parallelism vs QINCo; the abstract lacks datasets, rate-distortion curves, latency/throughput numbers, and key ablations.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“向量tokenizer/latent压缩”的工程备选：重点看并行解码怎么做、以及RQ/QINCo特例化推导；别指望直接改LLM预训练。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an engineering option for vector tokenizers/latent compression: focus on how parallel decoding is enabled and the RQ/QINCo-as-special-cases derivation; it won’t directly move LLM pretraining.

paper.title: EMO: Frustratingly Easy Progressive Training of Extendable MoE
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer a powerful way to scale model size without increasing compute, as per-token FLOPs depend only on k active experts rather than the total pool of E experts. Yet, this asymmetry creates an MoE efficiency paradox in practice: adding more experts balloons memory and communication costs, making actual training inefficient. We argue that this bottleneck arises in part because current MoE training allocates too many experts from the beginning, even though ear

summary.core_problem: MoE 预训练中存在“效率悖论”：虽然理论上增加专家数量（E）不增加每 token 的 FLOPs，但由于通信、显存和小算子开销，实际训练的 wall-clock 时间会显著增加。而在训练早期，数据量不足以充分利用大量专家的容量，导致早期分配大量专家既无必要又低效。
summary.importance: 提出了一种渐进式 MoE 训练范式，打破了预训练全程固定专家数量的惯例。通过将 MoE 容量视为可扩展内存，在不改变标准 MoE 架构和辅助目标的前提下，实现了计算和数据的更高效利用，为大规模 MoE 预训练提供了实用的降本策略。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EMO (Extendable Mixture-of-Experts) 框架。核心思想是：从小型（或稠密）模型开始，在训练过程中分多个阶段逐步扩展专家池（upcycling）。关键创新在于引入了显式建模专家数量 E 的稀疏 Scaling Law，通过拟合该定律来预测各阶段性能，从而精确计算每个专家容量所需的数据量，制定最优的阶段性 token 分配策略（前置低成本的小 E 训练，将大 E 训练留到最后）。
summary.experiments: 在 1.92T tokens 上，将 1.1B 稠密模型分五个阶段渐进扩展为 9.6B-A1.1B (E=128) 的 MoE。结果显示，EMO 最终预训练 loss 达到 1.017，接近固定 E=128 基线的 0.994（相对差距仅 2.3%），显著优于固定 E=64 基线的 1.065，同时节省了 10% 的 GPU 小时。下游 8 个 benchmark 评估也验证了 EMO 性能对标 E=128 且优于 E=64。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对 MoE 效率悖论的量化分析（图 1），以及如何通过 Scaling Law 确定扩展时机的部分。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The 'efficiency paradox' in MoE pretraining: while increasing the number of experts (E) theoretically keeps per-token FLOPs constant, it significantly inflates wall-clock training time due to communication, memory, and small-GEMM overheads. Allocating many experts early in training is inefficient because early-stage data cannot fully utilize this capacity.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a progressive MoE training paradigm that challenges the convention of fixing the expert count throughout pretraining. By treating MoE capacity as expandable memory, it achieves better compute and data efficiency without altering standard MoE architectures or auxiliary objectives, offering a practical cost-reduction strategy for large-scale MoE pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the EMO (Extendable Mixture-of-Experts) framework. The core idea is to start with a small (or dense) model and progressively expand the expert pool (upcycling) across multiple stages during training. The key innovation is explicitly modeling the effect of expert count E in a sparsity scaling law. By fitting this law to predict stage-wise performance, EMO precisely allocates the data justified by each expert capacity, resulting in a schedule that front-loads cheap, small-E training and reserves large-E for the end.
summary_en.experiments: Progressively expanded a 1.1B dense model into a 9.6B-A1.1B MoE (E=128) over five stages on 1.92T tokens. EMO achieved a final pretraining loss of 1.017, comparable to the fixed-E=128 baseline (0.994, a 2.3% relative gap) and significantly better than the fixed-E=64 baseline (1.065), while saving 10% GPU hours. Downstream evaluation on 8 benchmarks confirmed EMO matches E=128 and outperforms E=64.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the quantitative analysis of the MoE efficiency paradox in the Introduction (Figure 1) and the methodology for determining expansion timing via Scaling Laws. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 渐进式扩专家的思路完全可以引入内部MoE预训练pipeline，§3的稀疏缩放定律推导部分是核心贡献，值得复现验证
recommendation.en: The progressive expert expansion idea can be directly introduced into internal MoE pretraining pipelines; the sparse scaling law derivation in §3 is the core contribution worth reproducing

paper.title: Routers Learn the Geometry of Their Experts: Geometric Coupling in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models enable scaling language models efficiently, but training them remains challenging, as routing can collapse onto few experts and auxiliary load-balancing losses can reduce specialization. Motivated by these hurdles, we study how routing decisions in SMoEs are formed mechanistically. First, we reveal a geometric coupling between routers and their corresponding experts. summary.core_problem: 这篇文章要解决的不是“MoE 为什么能省算力”这种宏观问题，而是一个更底层、也更难回答的问题：Sparse MoE 里的 router 到底学到了什么几何结构，为什么路由会塌缩，为什么常见的 load-balancing loss 一边改善负载均衡，一边又伤害 expert specialization。作者试图从梯度和表示几何出发，把 router 与 expert 之间的关系讲清楚，而不是把路由器当成一个黑盒打分模块。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值很高，尤其对大规模 MoE 训练。文章的贡献不在于提出一个立刻替代现有工业路由器的方案，而在于给出一个机制层面的解释框架：router 与其对应 expert 在训练中会沿着相同输入方向累积更新，形成几何耦合；而常见 auxiliary balancing loss 会向所有 router 方向注入与输入相关的梯度，导致不同 expert 的 router 方向被拉近，从而削弱 specialization。这个结论直接触及 MoE 训练里的核心张力：负载均衡与专家分工不是两个独立旋钮，而是在参数几何上彼此牵连。对设计更稳的路由损失、理解 expert collapse、分析 DeepSeek/OLMoE 一类大模型中的专家分工，都有实质参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线分三层。第一层是理论分析。作者从标准 top-k sparse MoE 层的前向和反向推导出一个很关键的结论：对于某个被分配到 expert i 的 token，router 中与 expert i 对应的权重向量，以及 expert i 内部处理该 token 的权重，会沿着同一个输入 hidden state 方向接收梯度，差别主要在标量系数。也就是说，router 和 expert 虽然是两个模块，但它们不是各学各的；在被路由 token 的条件下，它们共享了同一组“输入方向历史”，因此会形成 matched router–expert directions。这个结论并不是“共享计算图所以梯度相关”那么泛，而是更强的输入方向对齐。第二层是经验验证。作者在一个从头训练的 1B 级 SMoE 上，比较 router 对 expert 的打分排序与该 expert 内部神经元激活强度，发现 router 排名更高的 expert，内部响应也更强；这说明路由决策并非外部硬分配，而是与 expert 的内部计算几何一致。第三层是对 auxiliary load-balancing loss 的再解释。常见 balancing loss 为了让各 expert 使用更均匀，会对每个 token 的所有 router 权重都施加更新，而不是只更新被选中的 expert。这会把原本由 routed token history 形成的 expert-specific 方向混合掉。作者理论上说明了这一点，并在实验中观察到：加入 auxiliary loss 后，不同 router weight vectors 的相似度接近提升到原来的 3 倍，几何上更趋同。基于这个分析，作者进一步提出一个 parameter-free centroid router：不用学习 router 权重，而是让每个 expert 维护其已接收 hidden states 的在线 K-Means/EMA 质心，路由时按与质心的 cosine similarity 选择 expert，并配合 sign-updated bias 调整负载。这个设计不是为了追求更高上限，而是验证“router 学到的很大一部分就是各 expert 所覆盖 token 分布的几何中心”。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕三个问题展开。第一，几何耦合是否真实存在。作者在约 1B 参数的 SMoE 上从头训练约 50B tokens，观察 router 排名与 expert 激活之间的对应关系，结果显示被 router 排得更高的 expert，在处理同一 token 时也有更强的内部激活，这支持了理论中的耦合假设。第二，auxiliary balancing loss 如何改变几何。作者训练两套除 balancing 规则外完全相同的 1B SMoE，对比 router 权重方向的相似性，发现带 auxiliary loss 的模型中，不同 router 向量彼此更接近，近似达到无该损失时的 3 倍相似度；同时负载更均衡，但 specialization 被削弱。第三，centroid router 能否复现 learned router 的主要功能。结果是它在所有变体里取得了最低的 load imbalance，同时 perplexity 与不使用 auxiliary loss 的 learned router 接近，只是有温和退化。摘要里没有给出完整 PPL 数字，但全文的重点不是绝对困惑度，而是证明一个非参数、基于聚类中心的路由器已经能覆盖 learned routing 的相当一部分作用。值得注意的是，作者把“更均衡”和“更好语言建模”明确分开讨论，没有把负载指标改善直接包装成整体质量提升。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇需要精读。先看理论部分，重点抓住 router 权重与 expert 权重对同一 token 的梯度方向为何会对齐。这里最好顺着公式把链式法则推一遍，否则后面的几何结论容易看成直觉描述。然后看经验部分里 router score 与 expert activation 的对应图，这一节把“几何耦合”从公式落到可观测现象。接着重点看 auxiliary load-balancing loss 的分析与相似度统计，这是全文最直接影响 MoE 训练实践的部分：它解释了为什么常见 balancing 虽然有效，却可能把 router 学成一组彼此相近的方向。最后看 centroid router 的实现细节，尤其是 online K-Means/EMA 更新、cosine routing 和 bias 调整方式。阅读时建议把它当成一个机制论文，而不是一个追求 benchmark 最优的模型论文。最值得深挖的点有两个：一是这种几何耦合在 top-1、top-2、shared expert、capacity constraint 等工业设定下是否仍然成立；二是能否据此设计只在未选 expert 上施加更弱、或更去方向化的 balancing 信号，从而少破坏 specialization。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a mechanistic question at the heart of sparse MoE training: what geometry does the router actually learn, why does routing collapse happen, and why do standard load-balancing losses improve utilization while often weakening expert specialization? Instead of treating the router as a black-box scorer, the authors analyze the joint geometry of router and experts during training.
summary_en.importance: This is highly relevant to pretraining, especially for large-scale MoE language models. The main contribution is not a drop-in industrial routing recipe, but a useful explanatory framework. The paper shows that router directions and their matched expert directions are geometrically coupled through training gradients, and that common auxiliary balancing losses interfere with this coupling by pushing all router directions with input-dependent gradients. That directly reframes a central MoE tension: load balancing and specialization are not independent knobs; they interact through parameter geometry. This has clear implications for routing-loss design, expert-collapse analysis, and interpretation of expert specialization in systems such as DeepSeek-style or OLMoE-style models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has three layers. First is the theoretical analysis. Starting from a standard sparse top-k MoE layer, the authors derive that for a token routed to expert i, the router weight vector associated with expert i and the expert weights processing that token receive gradients along the same input hidden-state direction, differing mainly by scalar coefficients. This is stronger than the generic statement that both modules are in the same computation graph. It means matched router–expert pairs accumulate updates from the same routed-token history and therefore evolve as coupled geometric directions. Second is empirical validation. In a 1B-scale SMoE trained from scratch, the paper compares router scores with the internal activations of experts on the same token and finds that experts ranked higher by the router also respond more strongly internally. So routing is not merely an external assignment layer; it is mirrored in expert computation. Third is a reinterpretation of the auxiliary load-balancing loss. Because this loss sends gradients to every router direction on every token, not only to selected experts, it mixes expert-specific directions and weakens the natural coupling induced by routed-token history. The paper supports this both theoretically and empirically. Motivated by that view, the authors introduce a parameter-free centroid router: each expert maintains an online K-Means or EMA centroid of the hidden states assigned to it, and routing is done by cosine similarity to these centroids, with sign-updated biases for load control. The point is not to beat learned routers outright, but to test whether a large part of routing can be explained as geometric summarization of expert-specific token regions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments address three questions. First, does geometric coupling appear in practice? On a roughly 1B-parameter SMoE trained from scratch on about 50B tokens, the paper shows that experts receiving higher router scores also exhibit stronger internal activations for the same token, which supports the coupling hypothesis. Second, how does auxiliary balancing alter geometry? The authors train two otherwise matched 1B SMoEs differing only in the balancing rule and measure similarity among router directions. With the auxiliary loss, distinct router vectors become nearly three times more similar, indicating stronger directional homogenization. Load balance improves, but specialization weakens. Third, can a centroid router recover much of the learned router’s function? The answer is largely yes: the centroid router achieves the lowest load imbalance among the tested variants while keeping perplexity close to the learned router trained without the auxiliary loss, with only a modest degradation. The paper is careful not to conflate better utilization with better language modeling; the empirical emphasis is on explaining routing behavior rather than claiming absolute perplexity gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one deserves a careful read. Start with the theory section and work through the gradient derivation; the key idea is why router and expert updates align along the same token direction. Without that, the later geometric claims can sound more intuitive than they really are. Then read the plots comparing router scores and expert activations, since they turn the theory into an observable training phenomenon. After that, focus on the analysis of the auxiliary load-balancing loss and the router-direction similarity statistics; this is the part with the clearest practical consequence for MoE training. Finish with the centroid-router section, especially the online K-Means or EMA update rule, cosine routing, and bias adjustment. The paper is best read as a mechanism paper, not as a benchmark paper. Two follow-up questions are especially worth thinking about: whether the same coupling survives in industrial settings with top-2 routing, shared experts, and capacity constraints; and whether one can design balancing signals that regulate load without injecting strongly direction-collapsing gradients into all router vectors.

recommendation.zh: 极佳的 MoE 机制分析工作！揭示了 Router 和 Expert 梯度更新的几何耦合，解释了为什么 load-balancing loss 会损害专业化，做 MoE 预训练的同学必须精读其理论推导和 1B 模型的实证分析。
recommendation.en: Excellent mechanistic analysis of MoE! Reveals the geometric coupling of gradient updates between routers and experts, explaining why load-balancing loss harms specialization. A must-read for anyone doing MoE pretraining, especially the theoretical derivation and 1B empirical analysis.

paper.title: HEBATRON: A Hebrew-Specialized Open-Weight Mixture-of-Experts Language Model

Training employs a three-phase easy-to-hard curriculum with continuous anti-forgetting anchoring, followed by supervised fine-tuning on 2 million bilingual Hebrew--English samples. The curriculum ordering alone yields a 3-point aggregate benchmark gain over the reversed configuration. Hebatron achieves a Hebrew reasoning average of 73.8\%, outperformin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是低资源、形态复杂语言在大模型时代的本地化预训练问题。更具体地说，作者关注三个互相耦合的难点：一是希伯来语在通用多语模型中的表示不足，尤其是词形变化、附着成分、无元音拼写带来的 tokenizer 和建模困难；二是继续预训练时容易牺牲原有英语与通用推理能力，出现灾难性遗忘；三是在算力受限条件下，如何用稀疏 MoE 底座做高效本地化，而不是从头训练一个专用模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一，这是一篇比较典型的 continued pretraining / localization 案例，重点不在新架构，而在数据配比、课程顺序、抗遗忘锚点这些训练设计。对于做多语种、领域化、持续预训练的人，这类工作比单纯报 benchmark 更有参考意义。第二，它给出一个明确结论：在语言本地化场景里，数据顺序不是边角细节，easy-to-hard curriculum 本身就能带来可测的整体收益，而且如果同时保留一部分原始基座训练分布作为 anchor，可以在提升目标语言能力的同时尽量守住英语和推理能力。贡献量级上属于扎实的工程型配方总结，不是范式级方法创新。
summary.technical_approach:
模型建立在 NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-Base-BF16 之上，这是一个总参数约 30B、单次前向激活约 3B 参数的稀疏 MoE 模型。作者选择这个底座有两个原因：一是 MoE 让本地化训练和推理更省；二是 Nemotron 的原始预训练数据分布公开，便于从中抽取高质量英语/推理数据作为 anti-forgetting anchor。

训练分三阶段，采用 easy-to-hard curriculum。虽然全文截取里没有完整列出每阶段的精确配比，但从引言能看出其设计逻辑：先用结构更规整、语言现象更稳定的希伯来语来源，如文学、法律、正式文本，帮助模型建立词法和句法基础；再逐步引入更开放、更噪声、更依赖世界知识和推理的网络与混合语料。这个顺序不是装饰性的，而是论文明确拿正序和逆序做了对比。

另一个关键设计是 continuous anti-forgetting anchoring。作者不是在本地化完成后再补英语，而是在继续预训练过程中持续混入一部分 foundation model 原始训练信号，尤其是高质量英语 reasoning 数据，作为稳定器。这样做的目的很直接：避免模型在希伯来语强化过程中把原有英语能力和通用推理能力洗掉。这个思路和常见的 domain-adaptive pretraining 相比，更强调“保留基座能力”而不是只追求目标域增益。

预训练之后，作者再做 supervised fine-tuning，使用 200 万条希伯来语-英语双语样本。这里的双语 SFT 也有明显意图：一方面提升 instruction-following 和任务适配，另一方面继续维持跨语种对齐，而不是把模型推成单语专用系统。方法上没有提出新的 MoE 路由或 tokenizer 机制，创新主要体现在本地化训练 recipe：MoE 底座选择、课程式 continued pretraining、持续锚定抗遗忘、再加双语 SFT。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的核心结果有三类。第一，课程顺序有效。仅仅把 easy-to-hard curriculum 换成反向顺序，整体 benchmark 平均就下降约 3 个点，这说明数据排序在本地化继续预训练里是实打实的变量，而不是可忽略的实现细节。第二，最终模型在 Hebrew reasoning 平均分上达到 73.8%，优于作者比较的开源希伯来语模型，并在 GSM8K-HE、Israeli Trivia 等任务上与 Gemma-3-27B-IT 保持竞争力。第三，效率上，由于采用 30B-A3B 的 MoE 结构，单次前向只激活约 3B 参数，作者报告在原生上下文长度下可获得约 9 倍推理吞吐优势。

从预训练视角，更值得关注的是这些数字背后的取舍。作者并不是追求绝对参数最小，而是用较大的总容量保留知识储备，再用稀疏激活控制成本；也不是做纯希伯来语单语继续预训练，而是通过 anchor 和双语 SFT 维持英语与推理能力。若全文实验部分包含英语保真、遗忘程度、不同 anchor 比例、不同阶段数据混合的消融，这些会比最终 benchmark 排名更有价值。当前可确认的最强证据是 curriculum 顺序的 3 分差异，以及“高希伯来语能力 + 稀疏推理成本”的组合。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不是看它在希伯来语榜单上排第几，而是看它如何组织 continued pretraining。先读 Introduction，作者把语言特性、低资源约束、MoE 选择理由、anti-forgetting 动机都交代得比较完整。然后优先找训练章节里三阶段 curriculum 的具体数据来源和配比，这是全文最值得借鉴的部分。实验里先看 curriculum 正序/逆序对比，再看是否有英语能力保持、anchor 消融、SFT 前后差异。如果这些表格给得完整，阅读价值会明显高于只看最终任务分数。

预计 20 分钟左右可以抓住主线。如果要深挖，建议重点问四个问题：一，希伯来语 tokenizer 是否沿用原底座，若是，形态复杂语言上的切分损失有多大；二，anchor 数据占比如何设定，是否存在过强锚定导致目标语言增益受限；三，MoE 路由在语言切换时是否出现专家偏置；四，curriculum 的收益来自“难度顺序”还是来自“早期高质量数据占比更高”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles language localization for a morphologically complex, relatively low-resource language under realistic compute constraints. In practice, it addresses three coupled problems: general multilingual models under-serve Hebrew, continued pretraining on Hebrew can damage the base model’s English and reasoning ability, and training a dedicated model from scratch is too expensive. The proposed solution is to localize an existing sparse MoE foundation model through carefully staged continued pretraining rather than architectural redesign.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the main value is methodological rather than architectural. This is a useful case study in continued pretraining recipe design: data ordering, anti-forgetting anchors, bilingual post-training, and efficient base-model choice. The strongest takeaway is that curriculum order is not a cosmetic detail in localization. The paper reports a measurable aggregate gain from easy-to-hard ordering alone, and it combines that with continuous anchoring to preserve the original model’s English and reasoning competence. That makes it relevant to multilingual adaptation, domain-adaptive pretraining, and continual pretraining more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Hebatron is built on NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-Base-BF16, a sparse MoE model with roughly 30B total parameters and about 3B active parameters per forward pass. The base model choice serves two purposes. First, sparse activation keeps localization and inference efficient. Second, Nemotron’s documented pretraining distribution allows the authors to reintroduce selected original data as an anti-forgetting anchor during continued pretraining.

The training recipe uses a three-phase easy-to-hard curriculum. From the introduction, the intended progression is clear even if the exact mixture details are not fully visible in the excerpt: start with more regular, formal, and morphologically stable Hebrew sources such as literary or legal text, then move toward broader and noisier web-style data that demands more world knowledge and reasoning. The paper explicitly compares this ordering against the reversed curriculum, which is important because it turns curriculum from a narrative choice into an experimentally tested variable.

A second key component is continuous anti-forgetting anchoring. Instead of localizing on Hebrew alone and trying to recover English later, the model is co-trained throughout continued pretraining with a curated subset of the foundation model’s original signal, especially high-quality English reasoning data. The goal is to retain baseline reasoning and English proficiency while improving Hebrew. After continued pretraining, the model is supervised fine-tuned on 2 million bilingual Hebrew-English samples, which likely serves both instruction adaptation and cross-lingual alignment.

There is no new MoE routing method or tokenizer innovation here. The contribution is the training recipe: sparse MoE as the base, staged curriculum for localization, continuous anchoring against forgetting, and bilingual SFT on top.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline findings are straightforward. First, curriculum order matters: using the intended easy-to-hard curriculum yields about a 3-point aggregate benchmark gain over the reversed ordering. That is probably the most informative result from a pretraining perspective, because it isolates data sequencing as a meaningful factor in continued pretraining. Second, the final model reaches a Hebrew reasoning average of 73.8%, outperforming the open-source Hebrew baselines considered by the authors and remaining competitive with Gemma-3-27B-IT on tasks such as GSM8K-HE and Israeli Trivia. Third, because the model is a 30B-A3B sparse MoE, only around 3B parameters are active per forward pass, and the paper reports roughly 9x higher inference throughput at native context length.

The more interesting interpretation is in the trade-off. The model keeps a relatively large total parameter budget for knowledge capacity, but uses sparse activation to control cost. It also avoids a purely monolingual localization path by preserving some of the original English/reasoning signal during continued pretraining and then using bilingual SFT. If the full paper includes ablations on anchor ratio, English retention, forgetting, or stage-wise data mixtures, those would be more valuable than the final benchmark table alone. Based on the visible content, the strongest evidence is the 3-point curriculum effect plus the combination of strong Hebrew performance and efficient sparse inference.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. The right way to read it is not to focus on leaderboard placement, but on the continued-pretraining recipe. Start with the introduction, which lays out the linguistic motivation, the rationale for choosing a sparse MoE base, and the anti-forgetting argument. Then go directly to the training section and look for the exact three-stage curriculum composition and mixture ratios. That is the part most likely to transfer to other localization settings. In the experiments, prioritize the curriculum-order comparison, then check whether the paper reports English retention, anchor ablations, and before/after SFT comparisons.

Roughly 20 minutes should be enough for the main ideas. If reading more deeply, four questions matter most: whether the original tokenizer is reused and how much that hurts Hebrew morphology, how the anchor ratio is chosen, whether MoE experts show language-specific routing bias, and whether the curriculum gain comes from true difficulty ordering or simply from presenting cleaner data earlier.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式突破，但对“小语种/垂直语种是否该上 MoE”给了可操作配方；重点看 curriculum 与 anti-forgetting 的 ablation，别太在意 benchmark 排名。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but a useful recipe for whether specialized languages should go sparse-MoE; read the curriculum and anti-forgetting ablations, not the leaderboard framing.

summary.core_problem: DeepSeek稀疏注意力(DSA)的多查询头索引器在长上下文下成为推理延迟的主要瓶颈，索引器开销占比过高
summary.importance: 工程与架构创新，提出可直接替换的稀疏注意力索引器方案，在保持效果的同时显著降低长上下文推理开销
summary.technical_approach: 将索引器多查询头视为专家混合池，用轻量路由器基于块级统计为每个查询选择少数活跃头，仅运行选中头的token级打分，大幅减少计算量
summary.experiments: 在DeepSeek-V3.2模型上验证，长上下文下索引器开销降低约一个数量级，保持原DSA的效果和精度无损失
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek团队，提出了业界领先的稀疏注意力机制DSA

summary_en.core_problem: The multi-query-head indexer of DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) becomes the main bottleneck for inference latency under long contexts, with excessively high indexer overhead
summary_en.importance: Engineering and architectural innovation that proposes a drop-in replacement for sparse attention indexers, significantly reducing long-context inference overhead while maintaining performance
summary_en.technical_approach: Treats indexer query heads as a mixture-of-experts pool, uses a lightweight router to select a small number of active heads per query based on block-level statistics, and only runs token-level scoring on selected heads to greatly reduce computation
summary_en.experiments: Verified on the DeepSeek-V3.2 model, reducing indexer overhead by approximately one order of magnitude under long contexts, with no loss of the original DSA's performance and accuracy
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek team, which proposed DSA, the industry-leading sparse attention mechanism.

recommendation.zh: MoE思路迁移到注意力索引器的设计很巧妙，做稀疏注意力长上下文优化时应参考其路由设计，重点看索引器实现细节
recommendation.en: The idea of migrating MoE design to attention indexers is clever; reference its routing design when optimizing sparse attention for long contexts, focus on the indexer implementation details.

paper.title: VisMMOE: Exploiting Visual-Expert Affinity for Efficient Visual-Language MoE Offloading
paper.abstract: Large-scale vision-language mixture-of-experts (VL-MoE) models provide strong multimodal capability, but efficient deployment on memory-constrained platforms remains difficult. Existing MoE offloading systems are largely designed for text-centric workloads and become much less effective for visual-heavy inputs, where large numbers of visual tokens induce broader and less predictable expert accesses. We present VisMMoE, a VL-MoE offloading system built on a single systems insight: pruning redunda

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是视觉语言 MoE 在单 GPU 或显存受限环境下的 expert offloading 延迟问题，重点是视觉 token 会激活更分散、更难预测的专家集合。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏推理系统。但它有一个值得保留的观察：视觉 token 压缩不只减少 FLOPs，也会改变 MoE router 的专家访问分布。这个现象对多模态 MoE 的架构设计、视觉 tokenizer、router 训练和 serving-aware pretraining 都有启发。多模态模型里的 token 冗余会通过路由放大成参数访问冗余，这一点比普通 token pruning 更接近基座模型系统协同问题。
summary.technical_approach:
VisMMOE 的核心概念是 visual-expert affinity。作者观察到，原始视觉 token 往往让 MoE 层访问较大的 expert working set，导致 cache reuse 下降、PCIe 传输增加、prefetch 失准。剪掉冗余视觉 token 后，专家访问会更集中，跨层也更稳定。

系统由几部分组成。Affinity-Aware Token Compressor 不只按语义重要性保留视觉 token，还考虑保留下来的 token 是否会造成分散的 expert demand。Compression-Guided Lookahead Predictor 利用压缩后的 token 和早期路由信息预测后续层需要的专家集合，从而扩大预取窗口。Expert Caching and Pipeline Orchestrator 负责在 GPU 显存、主机内存和 PCIe 带宽约束下协调计算、专家传输、缓存替换和 pipeline overlap。

和文本 MoE offloading 系统相比，它的区别在于把视觉 token 压缩纳入 offloading 策略，而不是只做 expert cache 或 router 预测。和常规视觉 token pruning 相比，它优化的目标也不只是精度和计算量，还包括专家工作集的紧凑性和可预测性。
summary.experiments:
论文在 commodity GPU 平台上评测了代表性的 VL-MoE 模型，并与实际可用的 offloading baseline 对比。给定内容说明 VisMMOE 能降低端到端推理延迟，同时保持接近原模型的任务精度。实验应覆盖不同显存预算、不同视觉 token 数量、不同 expert pool 大小，以及 cache/prefetch 策略。

给定材料没有提供具体延迟降低比例、准确率变化和硬件配置数值，因此这些数字需要直接查实验表。泛读时更应关注趋势：视觉 token 越多、expert pool 越大、显存越紧，visual-expert affinity 带来的系统收益应越明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看动机部分和 Figure 1，确认视觉 token 是否真的造成更分散的 expert activation，以及 pruning 后访问模式是否变集中。然后看系统设计中 token compressor 和 lookahead predictor 的接口，理解它如何把 token 选择和 expert 预取绑定起来。实验部分重点看端到端 latency、cache hit rate、prefetch accuracy、accuracy drop 四类指标。对基座预训练研究员来说，不必细读 pipeline 工程细节，但值得记下 router 分布会被视觉 token 冗余显著扰动这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies efficient offloading for vision-language MoE models under tight GPU memory budgets. The key issue is that visual-heavy inputs activate a broader and less predictable set of experts than text-only inputs, which makes expert caching and prefetching less effective.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining-method paper. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is the link between visual token redundancy and MoE routing behavior. Visual token pruning does not only reduce compute; it can also make expert demand more compact and predictable. This matters for multimodal MoE design, router training, visual tokenization, and serving-aware model construction.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VisMMOE is built around the idea of visual-expert affinity. The authors profile VL-MoE workloads and observe that raw visual tokens scatter expert accesses across layers. After pruning redundant visual tokens, the expert working set becomes smaller and more stable.

The system combines three components. The Affinity-Aware Token Compressor selects visual tokens while considering both task fidelity and expert-locality effects. The Compression-Guided Lookahead Predictor uses the compressed token stream and early routing signals to predict future expert demand, giving the runtime a larger prefetch window. The Expert Caching and Pipeline Orchestrator coordinates GPU memory, host-to-device transfers, computation, cache replacement, and overlap.

The difference from standard MoE offloading is that token compression becomes part of the offloading policy. The difference from ordinary visual token pruning is that the objective includes expert working-set compactness, not only semantic salience or FLOP reduction.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates VisMMOE on representative VL-MoE models and commodity GPU platforms. The provided content states that it reduces end-to-end inference latency compared with practical baselines while maintaining competitive accuracy. The relevant experiments should include latency under different memory budgets, cache reuse, prefetch accuracy, visual token counts, and expert-pool sizes.

Exact latency reductions, accuracy deltas, and hardware configurations are not included in the supplied material. The main trend to verify in the tables is whether the benefit grows with more visual tokens, larger expert pools, and tighter memory constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the profiling figures, especially the comparison between text tokens, raw visual tokens, and pruned visual tokens in terms of expert activation patterns. Then read the design of the token compressor and lookahead predictor to see how token selection is tied to expert prefetching. In the evaluation, focus on end-to-end latency, cache hit rate, prefetch precision or recall, and accuracy loss. The pipeline details are less central unless the goal is to implement a similar offloading runtime.

recommendation.zh: 系统味很重但 insight 真实：token pruning 会改变 MoE 路由分布与工作集；只看 affinity 定义和缓存命中/working-set 曲线。
recommendation.en: Systems-heavy but the insight is real: token pruning changes MoE routing and the expert working set; skim the affinity definition and the cache-hit/working-set plots.

paper.title: Adaptive Inverted-Index Routing for Granular Mixtures-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models enable scalable transformer architectures by activating only a subset of experts per token. Recent evidence suggests that performance improves with increasingly granular experts, i.e., many small experts instead of a few large ones. However, this regime substantially increases routing cost, which can dominate computation. We introduce adaptive inverted-index routing for MoE (AIR-MoE), an inverted-index-inspired routing architecture based on vector quantization (VQ

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 granular MoE 的路由开销问题。已有 scaling 结果显示，很多小专家往往比少量大专家更有利，但专家数增加后，router 需要对每个 token 和大量 expert centroid 做内积，路由本身会变成主要计算开销。核心问题是：如何在不把专家硬分组、不限制 expert 表示形式的前提下，近似 full top-K routing。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 MoE 架构可扩展性。它不是提出新的 MoE scaling law，而是试图补上 granular MoE 的系统瓶颈：当专家粒度继续变细时，稀疏激活省下的 FFN 计算可能被路由计算吃掉。AIR-MoE 的贡献量级更接近一种 router 设计和训练方法，适合作为大规模 MoE 预训练中的候选组件。它的关键价值在于把 MoE routing 明确建模成近似最大内积搜索问题，而不是继续依赖固定 expert group 或结构化 expert 参数。
summary.technical_approach: AIR-MoE 使用类似倒排索引的两阶段路由。第一阶段是 coarse shortlisting：用向量量化 codebook 将 token hidden state 分到最近的 codeword，再从该 codeword 对应的预计算 expert shortlist 中取候选专家。第二阶段是 fine scoring：只在 shortlist 内计算 token 与 expert centroid 的精确内积，再选出 top-K experts 做常规 MoE dispatch。这样保留了 top-K routing 的形式，但避免对全部 experts 打分。它和 hierarchical MoE 的区别是，expert 不被固定划分到互斥组里，shortlist 可以重叠；它和结构化 router 的区别是，不要求 expert centroid 满足特殊参数约束。难点在于 codeword 分配不可微。论文采用 bi-level optimization：router 和模型参数仍用梯度下降训练，codebook 用梯度无关的 adaptive spherical k-means 更新，以适应训练过程中 hidden state 分布的漂移。理论部分给出 mass recall 的下界，说明 shortlist 能保留多少原始 top-K routing 概率质量；下界依赖量化误差，以及落在 top-M codeword 分数之外的 routing mass。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 AIR-MoE 在 granular MoE 设置下通常优于已有低成本路由方法，目标是在接近 full top-K routing 效果的同时降低路由 FLOPs。给出的材料没有包含完整实验表格和具体数值，因此不宜过度解读结果幅度。更关键的实验应关注三类对比：与 full top-K routing 的质量差距，与 hierarchical/group routing 的性能差距，以及 shortlist 大小、codebook 数量、adaptive k-means 更新策略对 loss 和吞吐的影响。若这些消融成立，说明近似检索式 routing 可以在不牺牲太多 routing flexibility 的情况下支撑更细粒度专家。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的 AIR-MoE forward pass 和 Algorithm 1，确认 shortlist 构造、候选 expert 聚合、fine scoring 的实际计算路径。Section 3.2 值得看，因为 codebook 的训练方式决定了方法是否能在预训练动态分布漂移下工作。Section 3.3 的 mass recall bound 可快速读，重点理解量化误差如何影响 routing 质量。实验部分优先看和 full top-K、hierarchical MoE、结构化 routing 的对比，以及 routing FLOPs 是否真的从瓶颈中降下来。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the routing cost of granular MoE models. Empirical scaling results suggest that many small experts can be preferable to a few large experts, but this regime makes the router evaluate inner products between every token and a large number of expert centroids. The concrete question is how to approximate full top-K routing without forcing experts into fixed groups or imposing restrictive structure on expert representations.
summary_en.importance: The relevance for pretraining is in MoE scalability. The paper does not propose a new scaling law; it addresses a systems and modeling bottleneck that appears when expert granularity increases. If routing cost grows faster than the saved FFN compute, granular MoE becomes hard to train at scale. AIR-MoE is best viewed as a router design for large MoE pretraining, with the useful framing that MoE routing is a maximum-inner-product-search problem rather than only a learned softmax over experts.
summary_en.technical_approach: AIR-MoE uses a two-stage inverted-index-style router. In the coarse stage, token representations are assigned to vector-quantization codewords, and each codeword retrieves a precomputed shortlist of candidate experts. In the fine stage, exact router scores are computed only within that shortlist, and the final top-K experts are selected from the candidates. Compared with hierarchical MoE, experts are not partitioned into disjoint groups, and shortlists may overlap. Compared with structurally constrained routers, expert centroids remain unconstrained. The main training issue is that coarse codeword assignment is non-differentiable. The paper handles this with a bi-level scheme: ordinary model and router parameters are trained by gradient descent, while the codebook is updated with gradient-free adaptive spherical k-means to track distribution shift in hidden states. The theoretical analysis gives a lower bound on retained routing probability mass, depending on quantization error and the amount of routing mass outside the top-M codeword scores.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports favorable behavior against existing low-cost routing methods for granular MoE, aiming to preserve the quality of full top-K routing while reducing routing FLOPs. The provided content does not include full tables or exact numerical deltas, so the strength of the empirical claim should be checked in the experiment section. The important comparisons are against full top-K routing, hierarchical or grouped routing, and structurally constrained routing. The useful ablations should include shortlist size, number of codewords, codebook update frequency, routing FLOPs, and downstream loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for a first pass. Focus on Section 3 and Algorithm 1 for the actual routing path: codeword lookup, shortlist retrieval, and exact scoring inside the candidate set. Section 3.2 is important because adaptive codebook learning determines whether the method can survive pretraining distribution shift. Section 3.3 can be read for the mass-recall intuition rather than the full proof. In the experiments, prioritize the quality gap to full top-K routing and the measured reduction in routing overhead.

recommendation.zh: MoE 研究员应看路由复杂度分解和 VQ shortlist；若实验规模不大，先当可复现实验候选而非定论。
recommendation.en: MoE researchers should inspect the routing-cost decomposition and VQ shortlist design; without large-scale runs, treat it as a replication candidate, not a settled result.

summary.importance: 贡献是参数高效/显存高效迁移学习框架，结合混合精度量化和 side MoE。它对微调工程有参考价值，但不是 LLM 预训练方法，也没有直接讨论训练动态或 scaling。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 MP-ISMoE。先用 Gaussian Noise Perturbed Iterative Quantization 将权重量化到低 bit，并试图降低量化误差；再把节省出的显存用于 Interactive Side Mixture-of-Experts，扩大 side network 容量，并通过交互机制增强与 frozen backbone 的适配。

summary.authors_note: 机构为北京航空航天大学计算机学院。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets memory-efficient transfer learning: reducing fine-tuning memory while avoiding the performance loss caused by underpowered side networks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an efficient transfer-learning framework combining mixed-precision quantization and side MoE. It is useful for fine-tuning engineering, but it is not an LLM pretraining method and does not directly address scaling or training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: MP-ISMoE first applies Gaussian Noise Perturbed Iterative Quantization to lower-bit weights while reducing quantization error. The saved memory is then used to scale an Interactive Side Mixture-of-Experts module, increasing side-network capacity while keeping backbone gradient computation limited.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify backbone models, tasks, bit-widths, memory savings, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears focused on the memory-performance trade-off in transfer learning.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is the School of Computer Science and Engineering, Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 这是 PEFT/METL 工程组合，读方法图即可；没有预训练层面的新信号，别占用深读时间。
recommendation.en: This is a PEFT/METL engineering combination; the method diagram is enough, with no new signal for pretraining.

Approximate computing and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have each been studied as independent routes towards efficient inference, the former by replacing exact arithmetic with low-power approximate multipliers, the latter by routing inputs through specialized expert sub-networks to enable conditional computation. However, their interaction rema
